title: NEEDED: AI Video Creator Google Flow & Veo Talking-Head Expert
description:
AI Video Creator — Google Flow & Veo



We are looking for an **experienced AI Video Creator** who specializes in **Google Flow and Google Veo** to create realistic, high-quality social media videos.



The #1 requirement is **CONSISTENCY**.



You must be able to keep the **same character, face, clothing, location, objects, lighting and visual style across multiple scenes**. We do not want obvious AI changes between shots.



You Must Have Experience With:



* Google Flow

* Google Veo / Veo 3

* Advanced AI prompting

* Character and scene consistency

* Reference images

* Image-to-video

* Multiple camera angles with strong continuity

* Fixing/regenerating inconsistent AI shots



This is **not an entry-level role**. You should already know how to control AI generations and create multiple shots that look like they belong to the **same continuous video**.



Quality We Expect + niche





### To Apply



Start your application with **“FLOW EXPERT”** and send:



1. Your best Google Flow/Veo examples

2. An example showing the **same AI character across multiple scenes**

3. A brief explanation of how you maintain consistency

4. The AI tools you use

5. Your hourly or weekly rate



There is **consistent, long-term work** available for the right person. We want someone who can become our **go-to AI video creator**.

title: Content Quality & Localization Analyst
description:
Content Quality & Localization Analyst 



Full-Time | Remote | Starting $2.00/hour ( training period 2-3 weeks ) | Hired: $3.00/hour | Starting Date: Immediately



Who we are:



This is one of those rare opportunities where joining early actually matters.



We're an AI-first DTC e-commerce company across Europe. While many companies are still experimenting with AI, we've built our entire operation around it.



Today we operate multiple stores across Europe, and over the coming months we're expanding into several new markets — each with its own language, currency, and audience.



We're still a relatively small company. That means every new person has the opportunity to make a real impact.



This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant job.

Yes...

You'll prepare funnels.

You'll localize advertorials and sales pages into new languages and markets.

You'll follow SOPs.



But that's only the beginning — and honestly, the SOPs and the AI already handle most of the "following instructions" part. What we actually need is someone who keeps thinking after the instructions run out.



We're looking for people who want to grow into much bigger roles as our company expands.

Everyone starts in operations. From there, people naturally grow into areas like:



* Localization & Quality Control Lead

* Data Operations

* AI Operations

* Automation

* Team Leadership

* Process Improvement



If you're only looking for repetitive work, this probably isn't the right company.



The most important thing about this role:



We can teach almost anything in this job. We cannot teach curiosity.



We'd rather hire someone who's never touched Shopify but once took something apart just to understand how it worked, than someone who's used every tool in the book but has never once asked "wait, why does it work this way?"



Here's why that matters so much for this specific role: 

our system (Library) already does 80-90% of the work automatically — scraping competitors, drafting pages, cloning them into new languages. It's good. It's also not perfect, and it repeats the same small mistakes in predictable places if nobody's paying real attention.



The people who do well here aren't the ones who follow the checklist and move on. They're the ones who read a line, feel that something's slightly off, and stop to check — even when nothing on the checklist told them to.



If that sounds like how your brain already works, keep reading.



About Library:



Library is our custom-built operating system. It already performs most of the manual work involved in launching and localizing a product funnel.



The AI gets most of the way there. It does not get all the way there.



Your job is where the last, most important stretch happens:



* Prepare and organize new product funnels

* Localize advertorials and sales pages into new markets (language, currency, cultural references)

* Review AI-generated and cloned content line by line before it goes live

* Catch what the AI or a first pass missed

* Keep pricing, guarantees, dates, and claims consistent with the source of truth across every market

* Organize workflows and keep operations moving



Over time you'll also learn how the entire business works behind the scenes.



What quality control actually looks like here:



A few real examples of the kind of thing that needs catching before a page goes live — not because a checklist says to look for it, but because it just doesn't add up if you're actually reading:



* A guarantee that says "60 days" in one place and "90 days" three paragraphs later

* A price in the body copy that doesn't match the official price table for that country

* Delivery copy that still promises shipping to the wrong country after cloning to a new market

* A product name that's correct everywhere except one leftover sentence

* A reply in the comments section timestamped as older than the comment it's replying to

* An
 address that displays correctly but links to the wrong domain

* A translated page where one sentence was never actually translated



None of these are hard to catch. That's exactly the point. The bar isn't "can you catch this if someone points at it" — it's "do you notice it on your own, on page 40 of the day, when nobody's watching."



Who we're looking for,

This is much more important than experience.



We're looking for people who:



* Are naturally curious — you ask "why" before you ask "how"

* Learn extremely fast, because you actually enjoy learning

* Notice when something is almost right and can't just let it go

* Take things apart (literally or figuratively) to understand them

* Take ownership of a problem instead of waiting to be told

* Ask questions when they don't know something, instead of guessing

* Like working with systems and finding smarter ways to run them



We don't really care if you've used Shopify, launched
 Ads, or built funnels before. Those things can be taught in a week. What can't be taught in a week is whether you're the kind of person who double-checks your own work before calling it done.



You'll probably enjoy this role if...

* You've built or automated something simply because you thought it would be useful — not because anyone asked you to

* You've caught a mistake in something everyone else had already approved

* You often think: "There must be a smarter way to do this" — and then you actually go find it

* You use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini not just to get answers, but to understand things better





(Quietly noted: if you've read this far, remember the word Lighthouse. You'll need it later.)





Nice to have (genuinely not required): 



If you happen to have touched any of these, great — it means less ramp-up time. If not, it changes nothing about your chances:

Canva, CapCut, Shopify,
 Ads Manager, n8n, 
, basic HTML, Google Sheets/Excel, multi-language content or translation QA.



We mean it when we say these are bonuses. We've seen people with none of this on their resume outperform people with all of it, simply because they asked better questions on day one.



What you'll actually do,

Initially you'll learn:



* Funnel preparation and product launches

* Ad and page localization across languages and markets

* Line-by-line quality control of localized content

* Workflow organization inside Library



As you grow, you'll gradually receive more responsibility depending on your strengths — some people move into leading QA across a whole market, others move toward automation and process design.



What we offer:

* Full-time remote position ( 2-3 weeks training 8.30-16.30 fixed hours ) after that we see how much you know and you can get more freedom to schedule hours )

* Small, ambitious team

* AI-first company, built around modern tools from day one

* Opportunity to grow into different roles as we expand

* Internal training

* Daily use of modern AI tools

* Real career growth, not a repetitive dead-end task



We're building long-term. We hope you are too.



Before you apply

This probably isn't the right role if you...



* Need someone constantly telling you what to do

* Follow instructions well but rarely question them

* Only want repetitive work

* Skim past a small mistake instead of flagging it





We'd love to hear from you if...



* You're genuinely curious, not just adaptable

* You like making things better, even when nobody asked

* You want to grow together with a company that's still in its early stages



How to apply:



This job is about noticing details, following through completely, and doing the small extra step nobody asked for out loud. So the application works the same way — read the whole thing, follow every step exactly, and don't skip the one that feels optional.



1: Step 1 — Written answers:



Send us a short message telling us:



*Why this role interests you.



*What's the last thing you taught yourself — and what made you d
 to learn it, with nobody asking you to?



*Have you ever built, automated, or improved something simply because you thought it would be useful? Tell us about it.



*Which AI tools do you currently use, and how do you actually use them day to day?



*Describe a time you caught a small mistake or inconsistency that someone else missed. What made you stop and look twice, when everyone else had already moved on?





2: Step 2 — Prove you read the whole post



Somewhere above, we quietly asked you to remember a word. Put that exact word as the subject of your
. If it's not there, we'll assume this posting didn't get a full read — which tells us something too.



3: Step 3 — A 30-second video

Record a short video, 30 seconds or less, telling us why we should hire you for this specific role. Camera-facing, just you talking — no editing required, no production value expected. We're not judging the video quality. We're seeing how you think and communicate in 30 seconds flat.





4: Step 4 — Send everything to one place

 your written answers, the word from Step 2, and your video to:







We're not scheduling calls or interviews at this stage. This
 — completeness, the word, and the video — is how we'll d
 who moves forward. Incomplete applications (missing the word, missing the video, or answers that clearly skip questions) won't move forward, no matter how strong the resume looks.

title: YouTube Script Writer for Educational Channel (Long-Form Videos)
description:
We teach people (mostly women aged 25 - 55) how to sell digital products on Etsy. We need someone who can turn a video outline into a full script that sounds like us and gets people to take action, not just watch.



—————————————



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Turn outlines into full scripts, with a strong hook, clear structure, and a clear payoff

- Write in our voice: simple, direct, and friendly, like a teacher, not a textbook

- Add clear calls to action throughout the script tied to our paid course

- Do some research to fill in real numbers, examples, or facts the outline does not cover

- Keep scripts easy to read out loud. We record straight from your script, so it must sound natural when spoken.

- Start with 7 scripts a month. Grow to 8 scripts a month.



—————————————



WHO THIS IS FOR

- You understand that a script’s job does not end when someone finishes watching. It should move them closer to buying.

- You have written YouTube scripts before, and you can show us the videos

- You understand hook writing as a skill

- You can write in someone else’s voice and tone, not just your own

- You have experience with, or real interest in, courses, coaching, or online business content. Etsy, e-commerce, or “make money online” videos are a big plus.

- You can take a short outline and turn it into a full script. You do not need every detail spelled out for you.

- You hit deadlines without being chased



Please DO NOT apply if:

- You have only written scripts for fun or entertainment channels, with no experience tying a script to a sale or a sign up

- You need a finished outline with every word planned out before you can write

- You cannot show us real scripts you have written



In short: we want a strong writer who can sound like us, hook a viewer fast, and never forget that the real goal is a sale, not just a view.



—————————————



PAY

$50 per script, covering 7 scripts per month. This matches typical entry-level rates for this kind of work. As we grow to 8+ scripts a month and this role proves its value, pay can grow too.



—————————————



HOW TO APPLY



Show Your Work

- Link 2 to 3 YouTube scripts you have written that did well. Tell us which parts were yours if you didn’t write the entire script.



- Start your application with “Turn Views Into Sales.” This tells us you read the whole post.



***If you contact us outside of this platform you will be AUTOMATICALLY DISQUALIFIED.



—————————————



MORE DETAILS

- Fully remote

- This can grow into a long-term role for the right person.

- A paid 30-day trial before any ongoing work

- Pay can grow as this role helps bring in more sales

We're scaling rapidly and building a small team of detail-oriented people to help us produce demos at volume. This is real, consistent work with a clear process.

This isn't just task work. We're building something real. The people who join now in Phase 1 and prove themselves will be FIRST in line for:

Every demo follows the exact same process. You'll be trained on each step with video walkthroughs. No guesswork.



Open our tracking spreadsheet and claim your next batch of personal trainers

Research the PT: visit their gym profile page, find their Instagram, save their photos and bio info

Open our AI tool and paste our pre-written master prompt along with the PT's details and photos — the AI builds the entire website. You don't write or design anything.

Prepare a companion PDF using a template (fill in yellow fields, export as PDF)

Update 6–8 columns in the tracking spreadsheet (dates, links, status)

That's it. Once trained, each demo takes approximately 20 minutes. The AI does the heavy lifting. You manage the inputs, quality-check the output, and keep the spreadsheet updated. If it takes longer it won't be because of more work — just waiting for the AI to finish generating.

Every approved demo = $0.25 USD

* 25 demos/week (minimum target) = $6.25/week = $25/month base + $20–100 in bonuses = $45–125/month

* 35 demos/week (strong performer) = $8.75/week = $35/month base + $20–100 in bonuses = $55–135/month

* Detail-oriented — correct spelling of names, accurate data entry, proper file naming. This is the #1 skill for this role.

* Self-motivated — manage your own time and hit weekly targets without daily supervision.

* Willing to sign an NDA — our process is proprietary. Standard confidentiality agreement.

mber. Use information from their actual bio.

title: Dental RCM Operations Lead
description:
Dental RCM Operations Lead

Company: Dentistry Automation

Employment: Full-time, remote

Location: Philippines preferred; qualified candidates elsewhere welcome

Schedule: Monday–Friday, night shift aligned with US Eastern business hours (EST/EDT). Full-shift availability is mandatory.

About the role

Dentistry Automation is hiring a hands-on Dental RCM Operations Lead to manage end-to-end revenue cycle operations for US dental practices and DSOs.

You will lead our remote team across insurance verification, claims submission, payment posting, reconciliation, accounts receivable follow-up and denial management, according to each client’s contracted services.

Payment posting, reconciliation and quality control are immediate priorities. Strong hands-on expertise in these areas is essential—not optional.

This is a working leadership role. You must be able to investigate a patient ledger, identify an incorrect adjustment, resolve a claim issue, coach agents and communicate clearly with US dental offices.

Responsibilities

End-to-end dental RCM

Oversee insurance eligibility and benefits verification, coverage documentation and required preauthorization or predetermination workflows.

Ensure claims are complete, accurate and submitted promptly with required documentation and attachments.

Monitor rejected, denied, unpaid and underpaid claims; oversee corrections, appeals and payer follow-up.

Manage insurance and patient AR work queues, aging priorities and escalation of unresolved balances.

Coordinate secondary claims and patient-balance follow-up according to client policies.

Identify where revenue is being delayed or lost and implement corrective action.

Payment posting and reconciliation — core focus

Oversee insurance and patient payment posting, contractual adjustments, denials and patient-responsibility allocation.

Review EOBs/ERAs and patient ledgers to identify incorrect postings, duplicate entries, unapplied payments and balance discrepancies.

Reconcile posted payments against payment batches, remittances and available deposit records.

Investigate underpayments, credit balances and complex posting exceptions.

Ensure adjustments, write-offs and refunds follow approved client policies and authorization requirements.

Establish independent quality checks and verify corrections before issues are closed.

Team leadership and quality

Manage daily work allocation, staffing, productivity, backlogs and turnaround times across RCM functions.

Establish clear owners, backups and escalation paths.

Conduct quality audits, maintain error logs and address recurring problems through root-cause analysis and coaching.

Create and maintain client-specific SOPs, training materials and operational checklists.

Interview candidates, provide written recommendations and train new team members.

Develop working team leads so routine operations do not depend on one person.

Customer communication and onboarding

Send concise daily updates covering completed work, pending items, blockers, owners and next steps.

Lead operational calls with US dental offices and DSOs.

Address complaints promptly, escalate account risks and follow issues through to resolution.

Coordinate operational onboarding, including contacts, access, workflow discovery, SOPs, team training and readiness checks.

Maintain a clear record of client commitments and delivery deadlines.

Process improvement and automation

Identify repetitive work that can be standardized or automated.

Provide the technology team with clear requirements, examples and acceptance criteria.

Validate automation against real workflows and help agents adopt it.

Maintain current records in DA’s operations platform.

Follow company and client privacy, security and patient-data handling requirements.

The technology team owns software development and technical fixes. You own RCM operational delivery, quality controls, team performance and customer follow-through.

Mandatory qualifications

At least three years of hands-on US dental billing/RCM experience, covering multiple stages of the revenue cycle.

Substantial direct experience in dental payment posting, EOB/ERA interpretation and reconciliation.

At least one year supervising or training dental billing staff.

Hands-on experience with at least one dental practice management system: Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, Denticon, Dentrix Ascend or Dentrix Enterprise.

Ability to work directly inside the PMS to review ledgers, post payments and adjustments, manage claims, investigate discrepancies and verify corrections. General familiarity or report viewing alone is insufficient.

Strong understanding of dental insurance, CDT codes, contractual adjustments, denials, secondary insurance and patient responsibility.

Clear spoken and written English, with confidence handling US customer calls and escalations.

Consistent availability for the agreed US Eastern night shift, including seasonal daylight-saving changes.

Reliable internet, backup connectivity and a private, secure workspace.

Medical billing, general healthcare BPO or customer-service experience alone will not qualify. US dental RCM, hands-on dental PMS experience and payment-posting expertise are mandatory.

Experience supporting multiple practices or a DSO and working across multiple PMS platforms is preferred.

How success will be measured

Payment-posting accuracy and reconciliation completeness.

Verification and claims turnaround-time compliance.

Timely follow-up on rejected, denied and unpaid claims.

Reduction in aged AR, preventable errors and rework.

Consistent customer updates and issue resolution.

Team productivity, coverage and independent ownership.

Automation adoption that reduces manual effort without compromising quality.

How to apply

Submit your résumé, expected monthly compensation, earliest start date and answers to:

Which dental PMS platforms have you used, for how long, and which functions did you perform?

Which RCM functions have you personally performed and which have you supervised?

Describe your payment-posting and reconciliation experience.

What team size and number of dental practices have you managed?

Give an example of a posting error, denial or AR problem you resolved and how you prevented it from recurring.

Have you directly handled US dental customer calls and escalations?

Can you consistently work full-time during US Eastern business hours?

Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical assessment covering payment posting, reconciliation, a claims/AR scenario, error detection and a short customer update.

Do not submit patient information or confidential documents from current or former employers.

title: Fitness Business Growth Strategist & Direct Response Marketer
description:
Fitness Growth Strategist & Direct Response Marketer



Remote | 20 Hours Per Week Initially | $750 USD Per Month | Opportunity to Grow Full-Time**



About the Role



We are looking for an exceptional Fitness Growth Strategist & Direct Response Marketer to work directly with the founder across a growing portfolio of fitness brands, creators, memberships and apps.



This is not a traditional marketing assistant role.



We're looking for someone who lives and breathes marketing.



Someone who understands fitness offers, consumer psychology, direct response, creative strategy, paid social,
 marketing, funnels and conversion.



You should be the type of person who naturally looks at a fitness business and immediately starts thinking:



How can we improve the offer?

What's the strongest angle?

What creative should we test?

Where is the funnel leaking?

What are the competitors doing?

What campaign could we run?

How can we improve conversion?

What should we test next?



We don't want someone who simply waits to be given a list of tasks.



We want someone who can be given a problem, think strategically and help take the solution all the way through to execution.







What You'll Be Doing



You will work directly with the founder on the strategy and growth of multiple fitness businesses.



Your role will sit across:



Strategy → Ideation → Creative Direction → Campaign Planning → Execution → Analysis → Optimisation



You will have regular strategy sessions with the founder where you'll discuss client performance, campaigns, ideas, opportunities and priorities.



Your responsibility is then to take that direction and turn it into real marketing execution.







Growth Strategy & Marketing Planning



You'll be expected to:



Analyse fitness businesses and identify growth opportunities

Develop marketing and growth strategies

Analyse customer journeys and funnels

Identify weaknesses and opportunities

Develop new offers and campaign ideas

Research markets and competitors

Plan launches and promotions

Develop lead magnets and acquisition strategies

Create clear marketing plans

Turn strategy discussions into actionable execution plans



We want someone who can take a conversation like:



"This client isn't growing as quickly as they should be. Here's what's happening. What do you think?"



And come back with:



"Here's what I found. Here's what I think the biggest problem is. Here's what I recommend we do. Here's the plan."







Direct Response & Fitness Marketing



You must have a strong understanding of direct-response marketing and ideally have experience within:



Fitness creators

Fitness influencers

Online fitness coaching

Fitness apps

Fitness memberships

Challenges

Transformation programmes

Consumer fitness brands



You should understand how to market products and services to a mass consumer audience.



This includes understanding:



Offers → Hooks → Angles → Creative → Funnels → Conversion → Retention



You should understand the psychology behind why people buy a fitness product.



We're looking for someone who understands the difference between simply "creating content" and creating marketing that actually drives:



Leads

Sales

Subscribers

Revenue

Retention







Creative Direction & Ideation



Creative thinking is a major part of this role.



You should be comfortable:



Developing campaign concepts

Creating new marketing angles

Brainstorming offers

Developing ad concepts

Creating hooks

Coming up with creative campaigns

Directing the creative for paid ads

Developing ideas for graphics, videos and landing pages

Analysing competitors and identifying creative opportunities



You don't necessarily need to be a world-class graphic designer.



However, you should have a strong eye for marketing creative and be capable of:



Creating basic campaign graphics

Producing marketing assets where appropriate

Using Canva and other creative tools

Using AI for creative ideation and asset creation

Creating strong creative briefs for designers and video editors



You should understand what makes creative convert, not simply what makes it look nice.





 Marketing



You should be comfortable owning the strategic side of
 marketing and, where required, helping with execution.



This includes:



 campaign strategy

Launch sequences

Promotional campaigns

Nurture sequences

Re-engagement campaigns

Customer journeys

 automation

Segmentation

Offer positioning



You should understand how
 fits into the wider marketing ecosystem.







Paid Ads Strategy



You don't need to spend every day inside an ads manager, but you must understand the strategic side of paid acquisition.



This includes:



Meta advertising strategy

Creative strategy

Ad angles

Offer testing

Campaign strategy

Funnel strategy

Audience strategy

Analysing performance

Identifying opportunities to scale



You should be capable of looking at performance data and thinking:



 "What is actually happening here, and what should we do next?"







Weekly Reporting & Data Analysis



You will be responsible for regularly reviewing marketing performance and turning numbers into useful insights.



This may include analysing:



* Revenue

* Sales

* Conversion rates

* Website performance

* Funnel performance

* Lead generation

*
 performance

* Paid advertising performance

* Subscriber growth

* Retention

* Customer behaviour



We don't just want someone who can make a spreadsheet look good.



We want someone who can say:



"Here are the numbers. Here's what they mean. Here's what changed. Here's why I think it happened. And here's what we should do next."



You should be capable of turning this information into high-quality, clear and professional marketing reports and strategy presentations.



Hands-On Marketing Execution



This isn't a role where you create a strategy and then hand everything to somebody else.



You should be comfortable getting involved in execution, including:



* Planning and building campaigns

* Creating
 campaigns

* Organising marketing assets

* Setting up and building client accounts

* Managing marketing infrastructure

* Building out campaign plans

* Creating presentations and strategy documents

* Preparing briefs

* Organising launches

* Coordinating tasks

* Supporting funnel and account builds



The ideal candidate enjoys both:



Thinking about what should happen.



And Helping make it happen



AI & Viktor



AI is a major part of how we work.



We are looking for someone who sees AI as part of their everyday operating system.



You should be comfortable using AI for:



* Research

* Marketing strategy

* Competitor analysis

* Ideation

* Campaign planning

* Copywriting

* Creative development

* Data analysis

* Creating presentations

* Building processes

* Improving workflows



We use Viktor and other AI tools extensively.



Previous Viktor experience is a major advantage, but it is not essential if you are genuinely AI-native and can quickly learn new tools.



We don't want someone who occasionally uses AI to write an
.



We want someone who naturally thinks:



"How can I use AI to help me do this better and faster?"







The Weekly Working Model



A major part of this role will involve working directly with the founder each week.



During strategy sessions, you'll discuss:



* What happened last week

* Client and campaign performance

* Key numbers

* Upcoming launches

* New ideas

* Growth opportunities

* Problems and bottlenecks

* Strategic priorities



Your responsibility is then to take that conversation and turn it into execution.



For example:



We discuss:



* What is happening

* What we want to achieve

* Ideas and opportunities

* Strategic direction



You then:



* Analyse the data

* Develop the strategy

* Create a clear plan

* Build the presentation or report

* Develop campaign ideas

* Plan the
s

* Develop creative direction

* Plan paid advertising strategy

* Coordinate what needs to happen

* Execute the tasks you can personally complete

* Brief other specialists where required



The following week:



You report back on:



* What happened

* What was completed

* What worked

* What didn't

* What the data tells us

* What you recommend doing next



This cycle repeats every week.



---



Fitness Industry Experience Is Important



We strongly prefer someone who has genuine, hands-on experience growing a fitness business, creator or consumer brand.



To apply, you should ideally have worked with:



* A fitness coach

* A fitness creator or influencer

* A fitness app

* A fitness membership

* An online coaching business

* A transformation programme

* A challenge-based fitness business

* A consumer health or wellness brand



You should understand the world we operate in.





The Person We're Looking For



You are probably a great fit if you:



* Live and breathe marketing

* Are obsessed with understanding why people buy

* Have strong direct-response marketing knowledge

* Understand fitness offers and consumer psychology

* Have excellent creative instincts

* Can develop strong campaign concepts

* Understand
 marketing

* Understand paid social

* Can analyse marketing data

* Can turn ideas into clear plans

* Are comfortable with both strategy and execution

* Have a high level of initiative

* Are highly organised

* Are commercially minded

* Are naturally curious

* Enjoy solving problems

* Can work independently

* Are genuinely excited by AI



Most importantly, you should be someone who can be trusted with a problem.



We want to be able to say:



"Here's what we're trying to achieve. Go and figure out the best way to make it happen."







Hours & Compensation



Initial commitment: 20 hours per week



Compensation: $750 USD per month



This role is designed to start part-time.



However, as our portfolio and workload continue to grow, there is a clear opportunity for the successful candidate to move into:



More hours → Full-time → Senior Growth Role**



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to grow with the company and eventually take on significant responsibility.



 How to Apply



Please provide:



1. A short introduction



Tell us who you are, your marketing background and why this role interests you.



 2. Your fitness marketing experience



Tell us specifically about the fitness coaches, creators, apps, memberships or consumer brands you have worked with.



3. Your strongest case study



Please provide an example of a fitness or consumer brand you have personally helped grow.



We want to understand:



* What was the business?

* What was the challenge?

* What was your strategy?

* What did you personally do?

* What marketing channels did you use?

* What were the results?

* What would you do differently today?



Please be clear about your personal involvement. We want to understand exactly what you were responsible for.



 4. Examples of your work



Please share examples of relevant:



* Marketing strategies

* Campaigns

*
 campaigns

* Funnels

* Paid advertising

* Creative concepts

* Presentations

* Reports



5. AI Experience



Tell us:



* Which AI tools you use regularly

* How you use AI in your marketing work

* Your experience with Viktor, if any

* Examples of workflows you have created using AI



6. Short Loom Video



Please record a 5-10 minute Loom walking us through your strongest and most relevant marketing case study.



We want to hear how you think.



Walk us through:



* The problem

* Your strategy

* Your creative thinking

* What you executed

* The results

* What you learned



We are looking for someone who can clearly explain both the strategy and execution behind their work.





Please Do Not Apply If:



This role is probably not for you if:



* You only specialise in social media management

* You only run paid ads

* You only write
 copy

* You only create graphics

* You need a detailed checklist of tasks every day

* You don't enjoy analysing numbers

* You prefer someone else to tell you exactly what strategy to follow

* You don't have a genuine interest in marketing

* You rarely use AI in your work



We're looking for a full-stack marketer who can think, create, analyse and execute.







The Opportunity



The successful candidate will work directly with the founder and have the opportunity to become a key part of a rapidly growing portfolio of fitness businesses.

Someone who can take a weekly strategy conversation and turn it into:

s → Execution → Reporting → Optimisation.

title: Short Term Rental - Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper



Company: Stay With Us MPB Ltd Location: Remote



Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday 



Reports to: Director / General Manager / Accounts Manager



About Stay With Us



Stay With Us MPB Ltd is a serviced accommodation management company operating a portfolio of 200+ properties across the North East, North West and London. We provide contractor, corporate and relocation accommodation, working with property owners under management agreements and distributing through Airbnb, 
, VRBO and Expedia alongside a strong direct booking channel.



We are a fast growing business with an active acquisition pipeline, and we are looking for a bookkeeper who can bring order, accuracy and pace to a high volume finance function.



The role



This is a hands on bookkeeping role sitting at the centre of a high transaction volume business. You will own the day to day financial records, reconcile income across multiple OTA platforms, produce and verify owner statements, and make sure the numbers coming out of Guesty tie back to the bank.



You will be working with hundreds of properties, dozens of owner accounts and thousands of bookings per month, so accuracy, structure and comfort with volume are essential.



Key responsibilities

Platform and booking reconciliation

Reconcile OTA payouts from Airbnb, 
, VRBO and Expedia against booking records in Guesty

Identify and resolve payout discrepancies, missing reservations, cancellations, alterations and resolution centre adjustments

Reconcile direct booking income and payment gateway settlements

Investigate variances between platform reporting and PMS reporting, and escalate where data integrity issues are found

Owner statements and payouts



Produce, check and issue monthly owner statements from Guesty across the full portfolio

Verify management fee, VAT, platform fee and recharge lines are correctly applied per the relevant management agreement

Cross reference owner statement totals against Guesty reporting before payment runs are released

Flag negative balances, pending approvals, historic adjustments and zero value anomalies before payout



Respond to owner queries on statements with clear, evidence backed explanations

Core bookkeeping



Maintain accurate purchase and sales ledgers



Process supplier invoices, cleaning and maintenance recharges, and staff expenses



Perform daily and monthly bank reconciliations across multiple accounts



Manage credit control on overdue owner and corporate account balances



Prepare and submit VAT returns



Support month end close, accruals and prepayments



Prepare month end management information packs for the Director



Reporting and analysis



Produce property level profit and loss reporting



Support revenue and profitability analysis across the portfolio



Assist with budgeting, forecasting and cash flow planning



Provide clean, reconciled data to the external accountant for year end

Systems and process



Maintain and improve the link between Guesty, the accounting system and the bank



Document finance processes and build repeatable SOPs as the portfolio scales



Support the financial onboarding of newly acquired portfolios and new properties, including bank detail changes across OTA platforms



Identify and remove manual re entry between systems wherever possible



Essential experience

Demonstrable bookkeeping experience in a high transaction volume environment

Hands on working experience with Guesty as a PMS, specifically owner statements, accounting settings, commission and fee configuration, and financial reporting

Direct experience reconciling OTA income from Airbnb and 
, including payout reports, resolution adjustments and cancellation handling

Strong bank reconciliation and ledger management skills

Confident with VAT, including partial and mixed supply scenarios

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, comfortable with lookups, pivot tables and large data sets

Experience with cloud accounting software such as Xero or QuickBooks

High attention to detail and the confidence to challenge a figure that does not look right

Able to work independently, manage a monthly cycle to deadline and communicate clearly with non finance colleagues

Desirable

Experience in serviced accommodation, short term lets, property management or hospitality

Experience with VRBO and Expedia reporting

AAT qualified or part qualified, or qualified by experience

Exposure to acquisitions, portfolio migrations or PMS migrations

Familiarity with PriceLabs, Notion, Slack or similar operational tools

Experience preparing management accounts



What success looks like

Owner statements issued accurately and on time every month, with minimal query volume

OTA income fully reconciled with variances identified and resolved within the cycle

Bank reconciled and VAT filed on time, every time

Clean, reliable numbers the Director can make commercial decisions from

Finance processes documented and scalable as the portfolio continues to grow



What we offer

A key role in a growing business with a clear expansion strategy

Real ownership of the finance function rather than a narrow processing role

Supportive team with an established operations structure



To apply



Please send your CV and a short note covering your experience with Guesty and OTA reconciliation to [insert
 address].

title: BD Manager - Crypto DeFi Partnerships (Uncapped Bonuses)
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start 





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: IT Sales Operations Coordinator
description:
MSP Telecom & IT Sales Operations Coordinator



We are an established Managed Service Provider (MSP) seeking a highly organized, proactive, personable, and detail-oriented Telecom & IT Sales Operations Coordinator.



This role supports our telecom and IT sales operations from deal registration and order submission through provisioning, agent coordination, commissions, reporting, and lead follow-up.



We need someone who takes ownership, thinks critically, and gets things done — not someone who waits for instructions or simply reports that they are “still waiting.”



Key Responsibilities



Telecom & IT Orders / Deal Registration



- Submit telecom and IT deal registrations and customer orders through carrier, vendor, distributor, and partner portals.

- Process orders with 100% precision — accuracy is non-negotiable.

- Verify pricing, products/services, customer information, service addresses, documentation, attribution, and all order details before submission.

- Track orders through provisioning, activation, shipment, installation, or implementation.

- Maintain accurate CRM, spreadsheets, portals, and sales records.

- Coordinate quotes, contracts, approvals, documentation, and other requirements.



Verify twice, submit once. Never guess at missing information.



Proactive Follow-Up & Problem Solving



- Proactively communicate with Channel Managers, agents, customers, carriers, vendors, and distributors.

- Regularly reach out to agents and Channel Managers for deal updates.

- Identify gates and blockers preventing opportunities or orders from progressing.

- Determine what information or action is needed and proactively get it.

-
, call, message, follow up again, or find another appropriate contact when necessary.

- Maintain clear next actions, owners, and follow-up dates.

- Make logical operational determinations independently when appropriate.

- Escalate only when a genuine management decision is required.



We don't want:



“I'm still waiting for them.”



We want:



“Here is what's blocking us, here is what I've already done, and here is the next action.”



Commissions & Agent Administration



- Compile carrier/vendor commission and residual reports.

- Reconcile commissions against customers, orders, activations, and agents.

- Determine which agents should be paid according to established compensation plans.

- Prepare organized commission payout reports.

- Track paid, pending, missing, disputed, or incorrect commissions.

- Investigate discrepancies and proactively obtain whatever information is needed to resolve them.



Management Reporting



You must be able to take a lot of information and make it easy for management to understand quickly.



- Prepare concise daily/weekly sales and operations reports.

- Highlight what changed, what matters, what's blocked, and what needs attention.

- Clearly identify next actions, owners, deadlines, and recommended actions.

- Create clean, easy-to-read spreadsheets, trackers, summaries, and reports.

- Turn complicated information into simple, actionable information instead of dumping raw data on management.

- Write clear professional
s and summaries independently.



You must be able to think, analyze, write, and summarize independently without relying on AI to do your work. AI can be a tool, but it cannot replace your own judgment, understanding, writing ability, or critical thinking.



Light Sales Development



This is not a high-pressure sales position, but you must be comfortable communicating with prospects.



- Follow up with new and existing MSP, IT, telecom, wireless, connectivity, cloud, and cybersecurity leads.

- Conduct light outbound outreach and follow-up.

- Build rapport and understand basic customer needs.

- Schedule qualified appointments for salespeople or Channel Managers.

- Maintain communication with prospects, referrals, and partner-generated opportunities.

- Make sure good leads don't disappear because nobody followed up.



Personality Matters



We need someone who is naturally:



- Friendly, warm, approachable, and professional

- Socially aware and able to read the room

- Comfortable communicating with customers, agents, vendors, technical people, and executives

- Persistent without being abrasive or annoying

- Able to adjust their communication style depending on the person and situation

- Confident and personable on the phone

- A strong written communicator

- Good at building and maintaining relationships



You should know when to send a friendly reminder, when to call, when to push harder, when to listen, and when to find another route.



Be relentless about the outcome while remaining pleasant throughout the process.



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



- Extremely organized and detail-oriented

- Proactive, resourceful, and accountable

- A strong critical thinker and problem solver

- Comfortable taking initiative without constant direction

- Able to make logical operational determinations independently

- Excellent at persistent follow-up

- Able to identify blockers, dependencies, missing information, and next actions

- Capable of managing many deals, orders, agents, vendors, and communications simultaneously

- Strong with spreadsheets, CRM systems,
, and online portals

- Able to turn complex information into clear action items

- Comfortable with light sales development and appointment setting

- Personally accountable for the accuracy of their work



Experience with MSPs, IT services, telecom, wireless, carrier services, technology distributors, VAR/channel sales, order provisioning, deal registration, commission reconciliation, CRM, or B2B sales operations is highly preferred.



What Success Looks Like



At any time, you should be able to tell management:



What's moving?

What's blocked and why?

Who are we waiting on?

What have you already done about it?

What's the next action and who owns it?

Which orders need attention?

Which agents need to be paid?

Which leads need follow-up?

What actually requires management's attention?



Our Standard



If information is missing — get it.

If something is blocked — work to unblock it.

If someone isn't responding — follow up intelligently and find another path.

If an order is submitted — make sure it's 100% correct.

If numbers don't reconcile — investigate them.

If a lead needs follow-up — follow up.

If management needs to make a decision — bring the facts, options, and your recommended action.



We are looking for someone who combines precision, initiative, critical thinking, organization, persistence, warmth, social intelligence, and common sense — and takes genuine ownership of getting the job done.

title: On-Camera Host / Presenter
description:
About the Role:



We are a growing portfolio of online media brands serving engaged audiences across meaningful niches including mental health, personal development, and wellness. Our digital newsletters reach hundreds of thousands of readers daily, delivering valuable content that helps people live better lives.



We're looking for a natural-born conversationalist to become an on-camera face of our brand. You'll

interview experts across different niches — hosting podcasts, online events, and video content that people

actually want to watch.



This isn't a read-the-teleprompter gig. You'll research every guest deeply before you sit down with them,

ask the questions their audience wishes someone would ask, listen actively, and steer conversations to

the most interesting places. The camera should feel like your natural habitat, and talking to strangers

should energize you rather than drain you.



If you're the person who can strike up a genuine conversation with anyone, who gets curious about other

people's expertise, and who lights up when the recording starts — this role was written for you.



What You’ll Be Doing:

• Host and conduct on-camera interviews with experts across different niches — podcasts, video

interviews, and online events

• Research each guest thoroughly before the interview: their background, work, opinions, and recent

activity — and prepare a question flow that goes beyond the obvious

• Lead engaging, natural conversations: active listening, smart follow-up questions, and the ability to

redirect when a conversation drifts

• Present and host live online events (webinars, panels, Q&A sessions) with confidence and energy

• Collaborate with our content team to shape interviews into engaging content — knowing what makes

a clippable moment, a strong hook, or a shareable insight

• Represent the brand professionally on camera at all times: appearance, communication, and conduct

• Continuously improve your craft: reviewing your own footage, refining your interviewing style, and

studying great interviewers



Requirements:

• Proven experience in front of the camera: creating videos, hosting online events, running podcasts or

conducting interviews — you'll show us footage, not just tell us about it

• A natural extrovert and conversationalist — you genuinely enjoy talking to people and it shows on

screen

• Zero camera shyness: comfortable on live streams, recorded video, and in front of audiences

• Strong research skills — able to independently prepare for an interview with an expert in a field you

knew nothing about last week

• An instinct for engaging content: you understand pacing, hooks, and what keeps viewers watching

• Fluent English — clear, confident, and articulate on camera• Presentable and professional at all times: grooming, wardrobe, background, lighting, and demeanor

on every recording



Nice to Have:

• Basic video/audio production knowledge (framing, mic technique, recording setup) so remote

recordings look and sound professional

• Experience growing an audience on YouTube, a podcast platform, or social media

• Experience coordinating with guests: scheduling, prep calls, and making experts feel comfortable

before recording



Who This Role Is NOT For:

• People who freeze, stiffen, or script every word when the camera turns on

• Presenters who talk more than they listen — great interviews are about the guest

• Anyone unwilling to put in the research hours before each interview — winging it shows



Work Details:

Location: Remote

Why Join Us?

Flexible remote work — Work from anywhere on your schedule

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Upload completed galleries to Pic-Time

• Maintain organized and consistent files, folders, catalogs, and gallery names

• Follow our presets, editing examples, workflow, and delivery deadlines



WE WILL PROVIDE



• Starter Lightroom presets

• Clear workflow instructions

• Consistent ongoing work for the right person

• Feedback and training during the onboarding process



REQUIREMENTS



• Experience using Lightroom

• Experience with AfterShoot, Photo Mechanic, and Pic-Time strongly preferred

• Strong judgment when evaluating focus, expressions, duplicates, composition, and storytelling

• Wedding or event photography experience preferred

• Very fast and reliable internet for downloading and uploading large RAW photography projects

• A dependable computer capable of handling large Lightroom catalogs and RAW files

• Fast, dependable communication

• Careful attention to detail and file organization

• Ability to follow an established editing style and consistently meet deadlines



COMPENSATION



The starting rate is $5 USD per hour, with the potential for consistent ongoing work and increased responsibility based on performance, reliability, and quality.



Selected applicants may be asked to complete a small paid trial project before beginning regular work.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following:



1. Your experience with AfterShoot, Photo Mechanic, Lightroom, and Pic-Time

2. Your experience editing weddings, events, headshots, or portraits

3. Your location and time zone

4. Your weekly availability and preferred working hours

5. Links to examples of your editing work

6. Your typical turnaround time for sneak peeks

7. Your typical turnaround time for a complete wedding

8. A screenshot or recent result showing your internet download and upload speeds

9. Your computer specifications, including RAM and available storage

10. The word “LIGHTROOM” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the complete post



Please do not apply if you have unreliable internet, cannot regularly work with large RAW files, or cannot meet agreed-upon deadlines.

title: Claude + Funnel, Funnelish Expert / AI Localization & Conversion Specialist
description:
READ EVERY WORD AND WE HIRE LONG TERM!



Claude + Funnel Expert / AI Localization & Conversion Specialist



We are a performance-driven eCommerce company operating primarily with direct-response funnels, dropshipping offers, paid traffic and international markets.



We are looking for a very high-level specialist who combines:



Claude expertise

Funnel building

AI automation

Localization

AI image adaptation

Proofreading

Target-market research

Direct-response eCommerce thinking



This is NOT a basic VA role and NOT a simple translation job.



We need someone who can take a proven funnel, understand why it converts, adapt it for another product or country, rebuild it accurately, localize every element, QA the final result and improve it for the target audience.



The ideal candidate is part funnel builder, part AI operator, part localization expert and part conversion-focused problem solver.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



You will work across our eCommerce funnels from initial research to final launch.



Typical projects may look like this:



We give you a winning funnel from the US market.



Your responsibility is to:



Study the entire funnel

Understand the target customer

Understand the offer and selling mechanism

Rebuild or adapt the funnel

Translate and localize it for another country

Change images where required

Adjust product visuals

Change cultural references

Adapt testimonials

Adapt currencies and pricing

Adapt units of measurement

Adjust names and locations

Proofread every section

Check the entire funnel against the target market

Test desktop and mobile

Fix issues

Deliver a final launch-ready funnel



The job is not complete because the words have been translated.



The job is complete when the funnel looks and feels like it was originally created for that market.



CLAUDE EXPERTISE



You should be highly capable with Claude.



We especially value candidates who understand:



Claude

Claude Code

Projects

Large-context workflows

Prompt engineering

Structured prompting

Reusable prompt systems

AI research workflows

AI-assisted coding

HTML/CSS/JavaScript generation

Content transformation

Translation workflows

Localization workflows

Automated QA

Data extraction

Bulk content processing



You should know how to turn Claude into an actual production system rather than using it like a basic chatbot.



We want someone who can build repeatable workflows.



For example:



Original funnel

→ Claude extracts structure

→ customer avatar analysis

→ translation

→ localization

→ copy adaptation

→ image requirements identified

→ localized assets created

→ funnel rebuilt

→ automated QA

→ human proofreading

→ final market check

→ publish



If you have built Claude workflows, scripts, MCP setups, agents or automation systems, tell us.



FUNNEL EXPERTISE



You should have real experience working with high-converting eCommerce funnels.



Experience with Funnelish is strongly preferred.



Experience with other platforms is also valuable, including:



Shopify

Replo

GemPages

PageFly

ClickFunnels

Webflow

Custom HTML/CSS/JavaScript



You need to understand:



Landing pages

Product pages

Advertorials

VSL funnels

Pre-sell pages

Checkout pages

Upsells

Downsells

Order bumps

Bundles

Sticky CTAs

Social proof

Reviews

Guarantees

Urgency

Scarcity

Offer stacks



More importantly, you need to understand why those elements exist.



We are not hiring someone to simply drag sections around.



We want someone who understands conversion.



FUNNEL COPYING / RECREATION



We frequently work from proven funnels.



You may receive a reference funnel and be asked to recreate it for another product, brand or country.



You should be able to accurately reproduce:



Page structure

Section order

Layouts

Spacing

Typography

Offer presentation

Product positioning

Comparison tables

Reviews

Testimonials

CTA placement

Sticky elements

Visual hierarchy

Mobile layouts

Checkout flow



You need excellent attention to detail.



The goal is not to create something vaguely similar.



The goal is to identify what makes the reference work and preserve those conversion principles in the new version.



HIGH-END LOCALIZATION



Localization is one of the most important parts of this position.



You need to understand that translation and localization are NOT the same thing.



A direct translation can still produce a terrible funnel.



You need to check whether the finished page sounds natural to a real native customer.



Depending on the market, this can include adapting:



Language

Tone

Vocabulary

Idioms

Currency

Pricing presentation

Date formats

Phone numbers

Addresses

Names

Testimonials

Measurement units

Product claims

Delivery language

Payment terminology

Guarantees

CTAs

Cultural references

Visuals

Customer expectations



We expect extremely high standards.



The customer should never feel like they are reading a translated American website.



TARGET MARKET CHECK



Before completing a localized funnel, you should think about the actual customer in that country.



You should be comfortable researching questions such as:



Who is the target customer?

What are their main pain points?

What terminology do they actually use?

How aware are they of this type of product?

Which objections are strongest?

Which benefits matter most?

What competitors are already selling there?

How do those competitors communicate?

What does a trustworthy local website look like?

What payment methods do customers expect?

What type of testimonials feel credible?

What claims might sound strange in that market?

What imagery feels authentic?

Are there cultural differences affecting the offer?



We want someone who questions things that do not make sense.



Do not blindly translate.



Think.



AI IMAGE TRANSLATION & LOCALIZATION



You will also work with visual assets.



For example, an original funnel may contain an image with English text embedded inside it.



We may need the same image localized into:



German

French

Spanish

Italian

Dutch

Swedish

Polish

Portuguese

or another market.



You should be comfortable using AI and image-editing tools to:



Extract text from images

Translate image text

Replace text accurately

Preserve the original design

Match fonts

Match spacing

Match hierarchy

Change currencies

Change labels

Adapt diagrams

Adapt screenshots

Localize comparison graphics

Rebuild charts

Change product packaging text where appropriate

Generate replacement visuals

Create localized lifestyle images



Experience with tools such as these is valuable:



ChatGPT image generation

Nano Banana / Gemini

Photoshop

Canva

Figma

Midjourney

Kling

Runway

Google Veo

Other image-generation or editing tools



The final image should not look like someone simply pasted translated text over the original.



It should look professionally designed.



PROOFREADING IS NON-NEGOTIABLE



You need extremely strong proofreading skills.



Before submitting anything, you should check:



Spelling

Grammar

Punctuation

Sentence structure

Natural language

Wrong translations

Untranslated English

Product names

Prices

Discounts

Currencies

Percentages

Guarantees

Shipping information

Testimonials

Names

Dates

Measurements

CTAs

Buttons

Image text

Mobile layouts



We do not want to receive a funnel with obvious mistakes and then become your QA department.



Your responsibility is:



Build it.

Check it.

Fix it.

Check it again.

Then submit it.



DIRECT-RESPONSE ECOMMERCE KNOWLEDGE



You need to understand eCommerce customers.



You should be familiar with:



Customer avatars

Pain points

Desires

Dream outcomes

Objections

Awareness levels

Market sophistication

Hooks

Angles

Offers

Mechanisms

Benefits versus features

Social proof

Risk reversal

Urgency

Scarcity

CTAs

AOV

Conversion rate

Upsells

Funnels



We especially value experience with dropshipping and performance marketing.



Our funnels are built to sell.



The goal is not:



"Does this page look beautiful?"



The goal is:



"Will this customer buy?"



AUTOMATION & TECHNICAL SKILLS



We want someone who constantly looks for ways to increase production speed without reducing quality.



High-value skills include:



Claude Code

Cursor

HTML

CSS

JavaScript

Python

APIs

Webhooks

n8n

Make

Zapier

Browser automation

Web scraping

OCR workflows

GitHub

AI agents

Automated QA systems



You do not need every technical skill.



But you need the mentality of someone who automates repetitive work.



If something takes 5 hours manually and can reliably be reduced to 30 minutes with AI and automation, we expect you to explore that.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You are probably a good fit if you:



Have strong Claude expertise

Have real funnel-building experience

Understand Funnelish

Understand eCommerce

Understand dropshipping

Understand direct response

Can recreate funnels accurately

Can localize funnels professionally

Have excellent proofreading skills

Can research target markets

Can adapt visual assets

Know how to use AI image tools

Understand HTML/CSS

Can solve technical problems independently

Have very high attention to detail

Can follow references accurately

Can work quickly

Can manage multiple markets

Think about conversion instead of just design



WHAT WE DO NOT WANT



Do not apply if you are only:



A translator

A graphic designer

A basic Shopify VA

A basic Funnelish builder

A copy-paste page builder

Someone who depends entirely on Google Translate

Someone who blindly trusts AI output

Someone who cannot proofread their own work

Someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every task



AI should make you faster.



It should not replace your judgment.



PAID TEST



The hiring process will include a paid practical test.



We may provide:



A reference funnel

A product

A target country

Existing product assets



You may be asked to recreate and localize part of the funnel.



We will evaluate:



Funnel accuracy

Localization quality

Translation quality

Proofreading

AI usage

Image localization

Understanding of the customer

Attention to detail

Mobile quality

Problem-solving

Speed

Overall conversion quality



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word:



CLAUDE



Then send us:



1. Three funnels you personally built or worked on

2. One example of a funnel you recreated from a reference

3. Examples of localized funnels you have worked on

4. Examples of AI-localized images or graphics

Then answer these three questions:



Question 1:

Claude translates a headline correctly from a grammatical perspective, but it sounds unnatural and weak to a native customer. What do you do?

We are looking for someone who combines:
