title: Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager runs the operational backbone of the business and acts as the Management Representative for our Integrated Management System. You will keep day-to-day operations running smoothly and compliantly — procurement, supplier, asset and access management, business continuity, document control and cross-department coordination across our UK and Philippines teams — while owning the QMS, ISMS and AIMS: maintaining them, keeping them audit-ready, running internal audits and management reviews, and driving continual improvement. You will also run the quarterly project cadence that keeps every department's projects on track. It is a hands-on governance and operations leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director, with scope to build an Operations Assistant function and automate recurring work.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integrated Management System & governance (Management Representative)

• Establish, maintain and continually improve the IMS across ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and report its performance to top management.

• Own the internal audit programme end-to-end — plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate audits, log findings and drive them to closure; act as primary liaison with BSI and external/certification auditors.

• Organise and facilitate management reviews; capture minutes, decisions and actions.

• Run document control: the controlled-document register, version control, scheduled reviews and approvals.

• Coordinate nonconformity and corrective/preventive action (NC/CAPA) across all three systems, tracking each to closure.

• Own the integrated risk & opportunity process: maintain the register, facilitate assessments,

drive treatments and recommend residual-risk acceptance to the Managing Director.

• Steward the scope, Statement of Applicability, policies and objectives, keeping them current.



Project & portfolio governance

• Run the quarterly project cadence across the business — review each department's projects to ensure they are running as planned, on scope and on schedule.

• Maintain the project tracker; surface slippage, risks, blockers and dependencies, and hold owners to their commitments.

• Report project status and portfolio health to the Managing Director, and keep BAU (run) work and project (change) work clearly separated.



Compliance, information security & risk

• Administer information-security operations: asset inventory, access identities and periodic user-access reviews, supplier/third-party security management, BYOD compliance, i
 logging and coordination, and change management.

• Maintain the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register and coordinate operational compliance (UK GDPR/data protection, sector and AI-governance obligations).

• Own business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness — plans, drills and tests.



Operations & resource management

• Run the procurement and purchasing process, including supplier onboarding and due diligence.

• Coordinate cross-department alignment – weekly scoreboards and accountability, townhall inputs and BAU governance.

• Manage company tooling and the asset lifecycle; support operational budgeting.



People & culture (in partnership with HR)

• Support HR on onboarding/offboarding, the recruitment pipeline, the training & competence framework, the PDP cycle and rota/payroll oversight (HR owns execution).

• Champion an accountability culture across the UK and Philippines teams, and maintain the competence & awareness (training) matrix.



Performance, reporting & continual improvement

• Own monitoring and measurement – KPIs, scoreboards and performance evaluation – and report to leadership.

• Drive continual improvement and manage organisational change.



Leadership, delegation & automation

• Line-manage the operations and people-support functions; delegate effectively, and build and develop an Operations Assistant role.

• Use work-management tooling (
) and AI-enabled automation to streamline recurring governance and BAU work.





QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & TRACK RECORD

We are hiring for experience. What you have actually run matters far more to us than the certificates you hold — a strong operator who has genuinely owned a live management system will always beat a certificate on its own. You should be able to point to concrete examples for most of the below.

• 5+ years in operations, quality or business-management roles, including at least 2 years managing people or running a function.

• Hands-on experience owning or running a live, ISO-certified management system in day-to-day operation — ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001 (ISO 42001 a plus). This means having actually maintained it — document control, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk — not simply holding a certificate.

• Direct experience of external certification audits — preparing for and being audited by a certification body (e.g. BSI or similar) and taking findings and nonconformities through to closure.

• Proven experience running internal audits (ISO 19011 principles) and managing NC/CAPA and a risk & opportunity register.

• Experience running a regular project review or cadence and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams or departments.

• Practical experience of information-security governance operations — access reviews, asset management, supplier/third-party risk, i
 handling and business continuity.

• Experience of document control / management-system administration.

• Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams (e.g. UK and Philippines) and working across time zones.

• Hands-on with 
 or a comparable work-management platform, and comfortable using automation or AI to reduce manual work.

• Experience line-managing, delegating and building out a team or an assistant function.

• Sound data-protection / UK GDPR awareness and the discretion to handle confidential security, HR and commercial information.

• Excellent English communication and stakeholder management at all levels, including with senior leadership and external auditors.

• Highly organised and self-directed — able to manage many concurrent recurring obligations to deadline with minimal supervision.

We prioritise proven experience over formal qualifications. A relevant degree (business, operations, quality or information management) is welcome but not essential, and ISO / audit certifications are a nice-to-have rather than a prerequisite — we will happily consider candidates whose hands-on track record demonstrates the same capability.



DESIRABLE/NICE TO HAVE (not required)

None of the below is essential — they are advantages. Where a certification is listed, equivalent hands-on experience is valued just as highly.

• ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification – a bonus, not a prerequisite.

• A project-management qualification or method (e.g. PRINCE2, Agile) or a comparable delivery track record.

• ISO 42001/AI-governance exposure.

• Cyber Essentials familiarity; a data-protection qualification (e.g. GDPR Practitioner, CIPP/E).

• Procurement/vendor-management experience.

• Continual-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma) or change-management exposure.

• Experience in a SaaS or technology business.

You are a self-starter, able to take initiative, and always check your work before submitting. You are a logical thinker, and have a positive, “can do” attitude even when approaching tasks you’ve never done before. 

You enjoy learning on the job and are genuinely interested in the world of ecommerce. You have a high EQ, and can warmly communicate with customers. You anticipate their needs and can diffuse potential issues before they become a problem.

You’re comfortable working across multiple tools and systems. Clear, professional written and verbal communication in English language is essential. No spelling mistakes, no broken grammar. We’d love you to show your personality in response to this application by sharing a photo of your favourite music artist and tell us why you like them, along with the other application criteria.

Researching, writing and optimising SEO content with AI support



----



Additional Responsibilities

As the business grows, responsibilities may expand or change over time. Any updates to responsibilities or scope will be communicated in advance, with guidance or training provided where appropriate. 





Working Hours, Availability & Communication

You will work 4 hours per day Monday - Friday, 9am-1pm UK time. 



Weekly tasks and priorities will be set out in advance. Any changes to the schedule or workload will be communicated via Slack and our project library.



If you log in for your agreed working hours and have not received a new update or instruction, you are expected to apply yourself proactively, follow SOPs, and continue with assigned tasks using your own initiative where reasonable. To highlight your proactivity, you’ll get extra points for your application by sharing 3 bullet points containing specific mistakes you found on our site that you could fix within a few minutes. Please indicate which URLs you found these issues on.



Training & Support

You will be given access to training SOPs provided as Loom videos. These materials are designed to support consistency and clarity, but the role requires someone who can operate independently once trained. You can also connect with out 2 existing VA's who will provide you with onboarding support.



Once onboarded, communication will take place via Slack, and you are expected to respond in a timely manner. All working time must be tracked using Hubstaff, and you will report directly to the Founder. All required system logins and tools will be provided.



-----



Essential Requirements

Strong customer service background

Good working knowledge of Excel or spreadsheet tools

Excellent written and verbal English

Comfortable learning tools via SOP training videos

Ability to work independently and take initiative

Reliable laptop or desktop (Windows or macOS) with at least 8GB RAM

Fast, stable broadband internet (minimum 20 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload, higher speeds preferred). Ability to provide a recent internet speed test screenshot and ISP details.

Backup internet option (e.g. mobile hotspot)

Quiet, professional workspace

Working webcam

Reasonable power backup solution

Reliable VPN with UK endpoints 



Desirable Requirements

You already have a ChatGPT Plus, Claude and/or  subscription

Prior, hands-on experience working with Shopify

Confidence using Canva



Trial Period

This role will begin with a 3-month trial period to ensure the role is a good fit for both you and the business. Performance, communication, reliability, and adherence to agreed working hours and processes will be reviewed during this time.

Successful completion of the trial will lead to continuation in this long-term role.



Pay Review

After 12 months, there will be an opportunity for a pay review, based on performance and the scope of responsibilities at that time.



Interview Process & Start Date

Shortlisted applicants will be contacted for a 30-minute video interview to meet the company founder. This interview is also an opportunity for you to ask any questions about the role and the business.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview on a rolling basis from 2 September 2026. 

You must be able to start on Monday 14 September 2026.



You do not need to work this year on Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, Rizal Day or Last Day of the Year, unless you would like to.



How to Apply. Please include the following aAny application NOT including the below on the first point of contact will NOT be progressed).



1. Confirm you can begin on Monday 14 September 2026

2. Your CV

3. A screenshot of a recent internet speed test with ISP/package details

4. A 1-minute video recording, clearly showing your face, where you introduce yourself and explain why you are applying for Ice Cold Spice. We do not accept generic video recordings.

title: Interior Design & Construction Coordinator / PM
description:
We are looking for a highly organized and resourceful Interior Design & Construction Coordinator to support NYC residential, high-end residential, and light commercial renovation projects. Deep working knowledge in Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing Engineering a big plus.



This is an execution-focused interior design and construction coordination role, with significant involvement in material sourcing, procurement, finish selections, vendor coordination, subcontractor coordination, construction sequencing, and field execution.



We are especially interested in interior designers or interior design project coordinators who understand how a design actually gets built.



You should have a strong eye for high-end interiors and understand appropriate materials, finishes, proportions, details, and quality standards — while also being practical enough to understand construction sequencing, installation requirements, lead times, budgets, and field conditions.



A major part of the role is taking a design or selection and carrying it through:



Design/Selection → Specification → Pricing → Vendor Leveling → Approval → Procurement → Delivery → Field Coordination → Installation → Punch List



You should be comfortable working with items such as millwork, cabinetry, mouldings, doors and hardware, flooring, tile, stone, slabs, plumbing fixtures, lighting, glass, mirrors, metalwork, paint, specialty finishes, wallcoverings, appliances, decorative hardware, and other architectural finish materials.



You should have enough construction knowledge to understand when different trades need to enter the project and what must happen before them.



For example, you should recognize that cabinetry may require blocking and coordinated electrical/plumbing rough-ins before walls are closed; stone may require final field templating after preceding work reaches the correct stage; tile requires proper substrate and waterproofing; and finish trades must be sequenced carefully to avoid damage and rework.



We want someone who notices details such as poor moulding transitions, awkward reveals, inconsistent grout joints, incorrect material transitions, misaligned fixtures, poorly located switches/outlets, improper paint finish, bad hardware selections, incorrect tile layouts, or details that simply do not look appropriate for a high-end project.



You should have both taste and technical curiosity. If you do not know the correct material or installation technique, you should know how to research it, speak with the appropriate trade or manufacturer, understand the options, and come back with a recommendation.



The position is also heavily involved in procurement and sourcing. You should be comfortable obtaining multiple quotes, leveling vendors apples-to-apples, finding alternate sources, negotiating pricing, tracking lead times, samples and approvals, and evaluating cost vs. quality vs. appearance vs. schedule vs. risk.



Most importantly, we need someone who is self-reliant and execution-oriented.



Do not simply forward information to management. Turn it into clear next actions:



Management: Approve / Buy / D

Field: Measure / Prepare / Verify / Install

Vendor: Price / Sample / Fabricate / Deliver

Coordinator: Follow Up / Schedule / Resolve / Confirm



If a specified product is too expensive, unavailable, or has an unacceptable lead time, research alternatives and present the best options.



If a field condition conflicts with the design, identify the issue and coordinate toward a solution.



If a trade cannot proceed because something is missing, determine what is missing and help get it resolved.



If work may require a NYC permit, inspection, licensed trade, DOB/LPC coordination, architect, engineer, or other approval, recognize it and flag it early.



Ideal Candidate



An interior designer, interior design coordinator, procurement coordinator, or construction coordinator with practical experience in residential or light commercial construction would be an excellent fit.



We value:



Strong taste and understanding of high-end interior finishes

Excellent attention to detail

Material and finish knowledge

Procurement and vendor sourcing experience

Residential/light commercial construction knowledge

Construction sequencing and trade coordination

Ability to read architectural and interior drawings

Budget awareness and ability to find competitive pricing

Fast communication and response times

Logical problem solving

Self-reliance and ability to infer the next logical step

Clear, concise action items for management and field personnel

Ability to follow through and close open items without continuous direction



When applying, please provide examples of interior projects you have worked on, your role in material selection/procurement and construction coordination, any experience with high-end residential interiors, relevant software, licenses/certifications, availability, typical response time, and desired hourly rate.



Please include a portfolio or examples of completed interior work if available.

We're now looking for anOutbound Sales Specialist  to help us acquire new B2B customers, nurture existing customer relationships and drive account growth across Europe and the US, with a particular focus on the European market.

, LinkedIn and industry events

This balance may shift throughout the year—for example, with a stronger focus on acquisition during non-peak periods and more focus on supporting existing customers during peak periods to ensure smooth operations

- Goal-oriented and comfortable managing both new customer acquisition and existing account growth



What We Offer

- An above-market competitive salary package, plus a fair and motivating commission structure linked to the orders and revenue you generate

- A fully remote position with the flexibility to structure your own working day

- Direct collaboration with our Global Commercial Lead and international teams

- Exposure to the European and US markets

- Opportunity to take ownership of projects and contribute directly to Printbelle's global expansion

- A dynamic, international and fast-growing working environment

- Long-term development opportunities as our global commercial team continues to grow

1. Initial call with HR (online, 30 minutes)

2. Interview with the Global Commercial Lead (online, 45 minutes)

3. Offer discussion

Stipend: TBD (open for discussion based on experience)





THE ROLE

You'll be building the actual software that runs our ventures — and learning how real software gets shipped in a

live, fast-moving business environment.

We don't have time for slow sprints. We have more ideas than hands. Dashboards our clients demand. Internal

tools our teams stitch together in spreadsheets. Client-facing portals that need to exist. Snap & Prospect

automation pipelines. And someone needs to make them real.

That someone is you — but we'll teach you how.



What you'll actually do:

• Build real, shipped tools — not homework projects. CRM enrichment scripts, onboarding workflows,

recruiter dashboards, automation glue between Gmail/Sheets/Telegram/Slack. You'll see your code running in

production within weeks, not months.

• Learn by doing — We'll pair you with our team on live builds. You'll see what good code looks like (and what

bad code looks like). You'll learn when an AI is being helpful vs. when it's confidently wrong. You'll ship messy

v1s and iterate based on real feedback.

• Own the full loop — Spec (usually from a Slack message or voice note), build, deploy, iterate. We give

direction; you ship.

• Treat AI as a co-builder, not a crutch — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf — these are your tools. You'll learn

to work with AI, not just at AI.

• Move fast — When someone says "what if we…", you'll prototype something demo-able in a day or two, not

request a Gantt chart.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You don't need 5 years of experience. You need the right foundation and mindset.



Must-have:

-Technically capable — You've built something that ran. A side project. A class assignment you actually

finished. A startup idea you coded. It doesn't need to be polished; it needs to be real.

-AI-native — You think in AI. You use Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor daily. You can articulate your actual

workflow (not "I sometimes use Copilot"). You're comfortable asking an LLM for code and know how to spot

when it's lying.

- Systems thinking — Either you're a CS/IT student or recent grad who understands databases, APIs, and

deployment, OR you're a business/entrepreneurship student who's built a venture or prototype and understands

how systems need to work to solve real problems.

-Hunger to ship — You get frustrated by endless meetings. You want to see your work in the world. You're

willing to learn in public.

-Communication — Half our briefs come as voice notes. You're okay with ambiguity and can ask clarifying

questions without needing a 30-page spec.



Nice to have:

-You've built something with Claude Code or Cursor and can talk about what worked/didn't

-You're comfortable with: Next.js, React Native, FastAPI, Node, Supabase, Vercel

-You've touched:
 bots, Gmail/Drive APIs, automation tools (n8n, Make, Zapier)

-You understand business tools: CRMs (HubSpot, Pipedrive), recruiting ops, or SME workflows

-You're based in the Philippines and understand SEA or Australian SME operations



THE OJT ADVANTAGE

This isn't a typical internship. You're not making coffee or organizing files.

-You'll ship real code to real users within your first month

-You'll learn modern development the way it's actually done in 2026 — with AI as a first-class teammate

-You'll work across the full stack — no "frontend only" silos; you'll touch API design, database schemas,

deployment, customer feedback loops

-You'll build a portfolio of deployed projects you can show future employers

-You'll earn a stipend (negotiable) + potential full-time offer at the end if it's a good fit

-You'll be paid for your time — not exploited as free labor



HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

1. A short note (200 words max) on:

• The most interesting thing you've built (could be a hackathon project, class assignment, side project, startup

idea)

• What it does

• What tools you used (especially if you used AI)

• What you'd do differently if you built it again

2. Show your work:

• GitHub links (even half-finished projects)

• Deployed apps or links to live projects

• If you built something with Claude Code or Cursor, please include it

Pick one and build it using Claude Code, Cursor, or your favorite AI-native tool. Don't polish it. Send us the

displays something useful

title: Accountability Coach — Up to $300/Mo Part-Time, WhatsApp Only, No Sales, No Calls
description:
READ THIS FIRST

Most jobs on this site are about tasks. This one is about people.

Momentum is a habit-coaching service. Our members pay a monthly subscription for exactly one thing: a real human being who notices whether they did what they said they would do. Not an app. Not a chatbot. A person who reads their week and writes to them like they matter.



We are hiring the people who do the noticing. If you are the person your friends message when things are hard, and you write kind, clear English, keep reading.



WE ARE EARLY, AND THAT IS THE POINT

We are a growing startup, not a big company with a call centre. You would be one of our first coaches.

That means two honest things. First, the roster grows as we grow — new members arrive through campaigns our influencer partners are running, so your numbers build over the coming months rather than landing on day one. Second, the people who join at this stage are the people who shape how this works. Our best coaches become Trusted, then Senior, then Lead — mentoring a small group of coaches, carrying fewer members, and earning an override on every member in their group. Those roles will be filled from this intake.



If you want a finished, fixed job with a fixed number on it, this is not that. If you want to be early in something and grow with it, it is.



Have a look at mymomentum.coach before you apply — the method, the science and the FAQ pages. That is the actual product you would be delivering, and if it does not appeal to you, this job will not either.



PART-TIME, AND GENUINELY SO

Six to ten hours a week at a full roster, spread across the week rather than sat in one block. You choose your own hours inside one daily window (see TIMING below). Most of our coaches will be doing this alongside study, family, or other client work, and that is completely fine — it is designed to fit around a life rather than replace one.



EXAMPLE OF A TUESDAY, START TO FINISH

It is 4pm your time. You open your coaching desk. There is one queue.

At the top: Grace has marked nothing for three days. The system already knows this matters, tells you why, explains what a good coach does here, and offers you five draft messages. You read her file first — at intake she wrote she wants to "walk 10,000 steps and sleep properly" — then make one of the drafts your own: short, warm, no lecture, asking what got in the way. Tap through to WhatsApp. Send. Mark it done.



NEXT: Daniel's birthday is tomorrow. One line, no habit talk, no ask.

Next: Priya has hit 7 of 7 days sealed for the first time. You name it specifically and attach nothing to it.

Four more people are in your queue. Eleven are not, because the app already nudged them today and nothing has changed. You are done in forty minutes.



The system does the watching, the sorting and the first draft. You do the judgement and the warmth. That is why this takes forty minutes and not four hours.



THE REST OF THE WEEK

EVERY SUNDAY (1-2 hours at a full roster)

Read each member's whole week. Find the one true thing to celebrate and the one thing to gently address. Adjust their plan if it needs it — most weeks it does not. Write a short coach note. Send every member a warm, personal check-in. Every member, every week, without fail.



TIMING: our members are in the UK, the US and elsewhere. You are matched to ONE region, so you keep one steady window rather than being on call around the clock.

* UK/Europe roster: be at your desk once between 3pm and 8pm Philippine time (their morning).

* US roster: once between 8am and 12pm Philippine time (their evening), or 9pm and midnight (their morning).

Tell us in the task which of those you could genuinely hold. You do not need to be available at 3am, and we do not want you to be. Anything urgent outside your window goes to a monitored escalation inbox covering your members' hours, not to you.



WHAT YOU NEVER DO

* Never mark a member's day for them. That belongs to them alone.

* Never shame a missed day. A miss is information, not a crime.

* Never pretend to be a therapist, doctor or crisis service. When something is bigger than habits you say so kindly and escalate the same day.

* Never put a member's information into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or any other AI tool. Not to draft, not to summarise, not ever. Your lead reads your messages, and flat, templated writing is obvious. This is a firing matter.

* Never repeat what a member told you. Confidentiality is absolute.



TRAINING, AND SKILLS YOU KEEP

Full training is provided. You work through our coach training programme — assessed modules covering the method, the voice, habit design, the rules that d
 when a coach speaks up, the weekly check-in, and where a coach's job ends. You need 80% to pass each module, with unlimited retakes, and you finish with a certification.

Then a practice fortnight. For your first two weeks you are paired with the other new coaches and you coach each other for real: you design their habits, they design yours, you both log honestly every day and run a proper weekly check-in. Nobody touches a real member until that fortnight is done. It is the fastest way to learn the job, and it means the first person you write to as a coach is someone who can tell you exactly how it landed.

Training and the practice fortnight are unpaid. You are paid from your first real member.

What you take away, whatever happens next: behaviour-change coaching, written client communication, difficult conversations, knowing where a duty of care ends and when to escalate. Those transfer to almost any client-facing role, and very few remote jobs on this site teach them.



The unusual part: every Momentum coach stays a Momentum member. You keep running your own habits on the same dashboard, logged honestly, coached by your lead exactly as your members are coached by you. We do not prescribe anything we do not live.



PAY

$10 USD per member, per month. 5 members = $50. 10 = $100. 15 = $150. 20 = $200. (You can earn more than $200 if you become a Lead Coach or based on your performance and reviews we feel you can handle more capacity without compromising quality)

Paid monthly by mobile payment (GCash) on the 1st, for the month before.

* Member cancels mid-month? You are paid the full month for them. Joins mid-month? Same. It evens out.

* You are paid from your first real member. Training and the practice fortnight are unpaid.

* Your roster grows as members arrive from partner campaigns. We add to it as fast as you can hold people well.

If you need to leave, we ask for two weeks' notice so we can move your members properly. Disappearing on people who trusted you is the one thing we cannot forgive.



WHAT YOU NEED

* A laptop or desktop computer. The coaching desk is not a phone tool.

* A smartphone with WhatsApp that you actually use daily.

* Fast, reliable internet. You will send us a speed test screenshot with your task.

* Excellent written English that sounds like a person. The single most important requirement, and not the same as perfect grammar. Warm, plain, short sentences. If you write "kindly ensure compliance", this is not for you. If you write "let's not let it become three days, what got in the way?", it might be.

* Genuine care. You will hear about drinking, debt, weight, grief and failure. You must receive that with total calm and zero judgement, every time.

* Reliability. A member left in silence quits. Sunday cannot be optional.

* Judgement. Half this job is knowing when to say nothing.

* Discretion. Nothing a member tells you ever leaves the system.



No psychology degree, coaching certification or technical skill required. Backgrounds that transfer well: customer support, community management, teaching, nursing, care, counselling.

Not for you if you want to run this on AI, are juggling five other clients who will make Sunday slip, or find other people's setbacks irritating.



***IMPORTANT*** PAID SCREENING TASK — REQUIRED!!!

Applications without it will not be read. 

Follow the instructions exactly. That is half of what we are testing.

Answer the following questions (Part 1-3) and submit them with your application in a document.



PART 1 — Did you read this advert? (4 mins)

Answer in one short line each. The answers are all above.

1. How much do you earn per member, per month?

2. What is the one thing you must never put a member's information into?

3. How much notice do we ask for if you leave?

4. How many days in a row without a mark does it take before Grace appears at the top of the queue?

5. What are the two things the system does for you, and the two things you do yourself?



PART 2 — Judgement (6 mins)

Choose A, B or C for each, then give ONE sentence saying why. The reason matters more to us than the letter.



Scenario 1. A member has kept every habit for 21 days straight and says nothing to you all week.

A) Message them to celebrate the 21 days.

B) Say nothing — they are doing fine and do not need interrupting.

C) Message them to suggest adding a harder habit while they have momentum.



Scenario 2. A member missed one day yesterday. Before that, three solid weeks.

A) Check in today so it does not become a pattern.

B) Leave it. One miss is normal.

C) Ask them to explain what happened.



Scenario 3. A member has marked nothing at all for four days. They were doing well before that.

A) Wait a few more days — chasing people pushes them away.

B) Message today, warmly, with no lecture.

C) Message asking why they have stopped and reminding them what they are paying for.



PART 3 — Your setup and you (5 mins)

* A screenshot of an internet speed test (speedtest.net or 
). Attach the image.

* What computer and phone do you use?

* Which region window can you genuinely hold, every day? 

--- UK/Europe roster: be at your desk once between 3pm and 8pm Philippine time (their morning).

--- US roster: once between 8am and 12pm Philippine time (their evening), or 9pm and midnight (their morning).

* What else do you do in a week — study, family, other work? We are asking so we can see this fits, not to rule you out.

* One habit you have personally kept for more than a month, and how you did it.



HOW TO SUBMIT

One document with Parts 1-3, including the speed test screenshot.

Name the file: [YourName]_Momentum_Coach_Task — for example, MariaSantos_Momentum_Coach_Task



QUICK SUMMARY

$10 USD per member per month, by GCash on the 1st. $50/mo at 5 members up to $300/mo at 20. 6-10 hrs/week, part-time, fits around other work. Full training provided plus a certification, then a two-week practice fortnight coaching the other new coaches. Matched to one region: UK/Europe (3-8pm PH) or US (8am-12pm or 9pm-12am PH). Laptop, smartphone and fast internet required. Growing startup — Trusted, Senior and Lead roles will be filled from this intake. 



We are building something where the whole promise is that a real person is paying attention. If you would be good at that, we would very much like to read your task.

title: Sales Follow-Up Specialist — Warm Inbound Leads (Path to Closer) · Full-time · Remote
description:
We're a performance marketing agency. We run paid acquisition for clients worldwide, and our sales happen entirely in writing on
 — with buyers in the US, UK and Europe.



Our leads come to us. They're warm. This is not a cold-calling role — you will not dial a single number, and there is no script.



Right now our inbound is growing faster than one person can hold, and the losses aren't at the front — they're in the follow-up. Buyers who asked a real question and waited. Clients who signed and never got chased through onboarding. That's the job: nothing goes cold on your watch.



What you'll do



Own every conversation where a customer is waiting on us, and clear it inside 20 minutes

Chase the middle of the pipeline — proposals, quotes, pending answers, open questions

Chase new clients through onboarding until they're properly live

Revive stalled conversations and hand the warm ones back to the closer

Report every week on what's open, what's moving, what's dead



Where it goes



This starts as a follow-up seat and is built to become a closing seat. Hit the standard for three months and you take your own live leads, with commission on what you close. We'd rather grow a closer than hire one.



What you need



You've handled customers in writing before — chat,
 or CRM. Support counts. Cold calling doesn't.

Clean, short, natural English. Our buyers read three-line messages on a phone. No formal letter-writing.

You can tell a "thanks!" from a real question without being told

You close your own loops. An unanswered message genuinely bothers you.

Reliable internet and a quiet setup, 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM Philippine time, Monday to Friday

Every other weekend you're on call — three 30-minute queue checks across the day, then you're free. The alternate weekend is completely yours.



Our clients



We work in regulated and high-risk verticals — crypto, online gambling, adult/creator platforms, IPTV and peptides. This is real, it's most of our book, and you'll be in those conversations daily. If that's not for you, this isn't your role, and that's completely fine — please don't apply.



Pay



$650/month base to start, plus up to $150/month performance — so $650–800 depending on your numbers

On promotion to closer: higher base plus commission on every deal you close

Paid trial task before any offer

Full-time, 40 hours, permanent



HOW TO APPLY — read carefully, we reject applications that skip these



Reply with exactly these four things, in this order:



Start your message with the word PIPELINE so we know you read this

Paste one real follow-up message you actually sent to a customer who had gone quiet. Copy it exactly as you sent it. Change the names if you need to. If you have never sent one, say so honestly — that's an acceptable answer, an invented one is not.

In two sentences: a customer asked us a question four days ago and nobody replied. What do you send now? Write the actual message, ready to send.

Your monthly rate in USD, and the earliest date you could start a paid trial.



No cover letter. No CV summary. We read every reply that follows these four steps.

title: Exceptional Virtual Assistant for Airbnb Business - 8AM - 4PM PST
description:
Day Shift Operations Coordinator

**Vo Rental ("Vo Place Like Home") — Anaheim, CA**



About us



Vo Rental owns and manages a portfolio of roughly 50 short-term rental and residential properties. The core of the business is in Orange County — Anaheim, Garden Grove, Westminster, Santa Ana, Midway City — with additional homes in Las Vegas, Panama City and Panama City Beach, FL, and Kissimmee, FL. We run a cleaning team of about 19 people and turn over homes every single day of the year.



This is an operations job, not a desk job. Guests check out at 11 AM and the next guests walk in at 4 PM. Everything we do lives inside that window.



The role



You are the person who owns the turnover day. From the first checkout message to the last house cleared, you keep guests informed, cleaners moving, and every turnover finished on time. You work alongside our night-shift coordinator, who hands you the day and picks it back up when you sign off.



Schedule and pay



- **Hours:** 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM PST (Pacific Standard Time, US West Coast)

- **Days:** Sunday through Friday. Saturdays off.

- **Pay:** $1,200 per month



What you'll do



**Turnover and cleaner coordination**



- Monitor guest messages and confirm when guests have actually vacated each home

- Notify the assigned cleaner the moment her house is clear

- Build and balance the daily cleaning assignments across the team; reassign when someone calls out, a booking extends, or a house gets added late

- Send each cleaner her next-day schedule and any special instructions (guest counts, supply drops, promised early check-in times)

- Track that every checkout has a cleaner assigned and every clean is finished before check-in



**Guest communication**



- Answer guest questions on Airbnb, 
, and direct channels — access codes, parking, early check-in and late checkout requests, local recommendations

- Handle same-day problems: a lockout, a missing item, an AC that isn't cooling, a cleaner running behind

- Keep tone warm and responses fast; most of our reviews are won or lost here



**Damage claims and documentation**



- Collect and organize post-clean photo documentation from cleaners

- Intake damage reports: rename and timestamp photos, gather receipts, and assemble the supporting file

- Maintain the claims tracker and prepare claims for filing with Airbnb / 



**Maintenance and supplies**



- Dispatch and follow up on repairs, pest control, jacuzzi service, air filter changes, water heater flushes

- Track consumables per property and get restocks to the right house before the next cleaning

- Confirm work was actually completed, not just scheduled



**Records and reporting**



- Log cleaner hours and cleaning fees for monthly payouts

- Support month-end owner and tenant statements

- Keep the task list, calendars, and property records accurate — other people depend on them being right



What we're looking for



**Required**



- Fluent written and spoken English

- Genuinely reliable with time. This job is built on deadlines that cannot slip.

- Strong written communication — clear, short, warm messages to guests and to staff.

- Comfortable running your own day across many small moving pieces without being chased.

- Working knowledge of Google Calendar, Google Sheets or Excel, WhatsApp, and a shared task manager. You should be able to learn a property management system quickly.

- Discretion. You will see guest information, addresses, access codes, and payment records.



**Nice to have**



- Spanish. Much of our cleaning team communicates in Spanish, so it helps every day.

- Prior short-term rental, property management, hospitality, or dispatch experience

- Familiarity with Airbnb and 
 host tools

- Experience coordinating field staff or contractors



**Not required**



- A college degree

- Prior experience with our specific software



What success looks like



- **First 30 days:** You know the properties by name, you know which cleaner covers what, and you can run a turnover cycle start to finish with occasional help.

- **First 60 days:** Guests get answers within minutes. Cleaners hear from you before they have to ask. Nothing on the calendar surprises you.

- **First 90 days:** You catch problems before I do — the booking that extended, the house with no cleaner, the guest who is unhappy but hasn't said so yet.



To apply



**You must include a Loom video or a YouTube clip with your application. I will not entertain any proposal or applicant that does not include one.**



In your video, introduce yourself and tell us about a time you had to fix a scheduling problem in real time — what went wrong, what you did, and how it turned out. Also confirm that you can work 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM PST, Sunday through Friday.



You must spend at least 10 AP on this application, or it will not be reviewed.

title: Growth Marketer for New Community Platform
description:
Oak Harbor Ventures is launching RailsDen, a new self-hosted community platform.



RailsDen provides discussion forums, member profiles, moderation, permissions, private messaging, Classic Chat, immersive 3D Chat, notifications, plugins and themes, and native community monetization through sponsorships, advertising networks, and ad placements.



It can run as a standalone community platform or be integrated into an existing Ruby on Rails application.



I am looking for someone to take ownership of customer acquisition and launch marketing for RailsDen.



This is not a position where I will hand you a list of websites and tell you where to post. I will provide the product, website, documentation, screenshots, product information, access to me for questions, and a limited campaign budget.



You are expected to research the market, determine how to reach potential RailsDen users, propose a practical campaign, and execute it.



The objective is not social-media activity for its own sake. The objective is:



- Increase awareness of RailsDen among people who operate or want to build online communities

- Generate qualified website traffic

- Drive RailsDen installs and real-world adoption

- Identify paid and unpaid acquisition channels that have a realistic chance of producing users

- Test approaches and focus effort on those that show meaningful results

- Identify audiences, channels, partnerships, and opportunities I may not have considered



Relevant audiences may include:



- Businesses operating customer or support communities

- Membership organizations

- Creators and publishers with communities

- Associations and professional groups

- Operators of existing forums and discussion communities

- Organizations considering self-hosted community software

- Users evaluating alternatives to platforms such as Discourse

- Businesses that want to monetize a community through sponsorships and advertising



CAMPAIGN BUDGET



The marketing and advertising budget is limited.



The initial maximum campaign spend is $150 USD. This is separate from your gig fee.



No advertising, sponsorship, paid placement, creator fee, software subscription, or other campaign expense may be incurred without my approval in advance.



The total campaign spend may not exceed $150 unless I explicitly approve an increase.



I am absolutely open to paid marketing when it makes sense, but I am looking for someone who can make intelligent use of a small budget rather than assuming that success requires thousands of dollars in advertising.



Free and low-cost opportunities are encouraged when they are genuinely relevant and likely to reach potential RailsDen users.



WHAT I AM NOT LOOKING FOR



Please do not apply if your entire strategy is:



- Generic daily
, X, LinkedIn, or Instagram posting

- Submitting RailsDen to random startup directories

- Buying followers, impressions, or low-quality traffic

- Treating likes and engagement as though they were customers

- Spending the entire advertising budget simply because it is available

- Waiting for me to provide the marketing strategy



I am looking for someone who can research the market, identify where prospective community-platform users can actually be reached, and execute an intelligent campaign.



Possible channels may include paid advertising, partnerships, direct outreach, publications, creators, newsletters, podcasts, comparison sites, online communities, sponsorships, or approaches I have not considered.



You are not expected to use every possible channel. I would rather see a few well-researched, targeted efforts than money and time scattered across dozens of places.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



The most important measures are:



RailsDen installs, qualified prospects, and actual users.



Awareness, traffic, clicks, impressions, and engagement are useful supporting metrics, but they are not the end goal.



WHEN APPLYING



Please answer the following questions:



1. Tell me about a software, SaaS, community, or technology product you have marketed.



2. How would you approach finding the first users of a new community platform?



3. Who do you believe the likely buyers or users of RailsDen are?



4. Give me three specific acquisition methods you would investigate first and explain why.



5. Given a maximum initial campaign budget of $150 USD, how would you d
 where that money should and should not be spent?



6. What would you measure to determine whether the campaign is working?



7. Tell me about a marketing campaign or tactic that did not work and what you changed afterward.



Do not send a generic marketing proposal.



I am specifically looking for someone who can think independently, research unfamiliar markets, make good decisions with limited resources, and focus on actual adoption rather than vanity metrics.

title: Google and Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
Google Ads & Amazon PPC Specialist



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Setup: Remote

Location: Philippines

Experience Required: Minimum 3 Years Hands-On Experience

Industry: E-commerce / Industrial & Commercial Products



About the Company (Tarp Supply Inc.®)



We are a U.S.-based e-commerce company specializing in tarps, custom covers, protective products, and industrial fabrics. We sell through our website as well as major online marketplaces, including Amazon.



We are looking for an experienced Google Ads & Amazon PPC Specialist who can take ownership of our paid advertising campaigns, improve campaign performance, increase qualified traffic, and generate profitable sales.



Position Overview



The ideal candidate has at least 3 years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Amazon PPC campaigns for e-commerce businesses.



You should be comfortable building campaigns from the ground up, conducting keyword and competitor research, optimizing bids and budgets, analyzing performance data, and continuously improving ROAS and conversion rates.



This is a hands-on position. We are looking for someone who can plan, launch, manage, analyze, and optimize campaigns independently.



Key Responsibilities

** Google Ads

- Create, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns for our e-commerce website.

- Manage Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, and Remarketing campaigns.

- Conduct keyword research and identify high-intent commercial keywords.

- Build effective ad groups, keyword lists, negative keyword lists, and audience targeting.

- Write and test compelling ad copy.

- Optimize bids, budgets, targeting, and campaign structure.

- Monitor CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, ROAS, and overall campaign profitability.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective strategies.

- Conduct A/B testing of ads, landing pages, audiences, and campaign strategies.

- Analyze search terms and continuously improve keyword targeting.

- Monitor competitors and identify opportunities for growth.

- Work with the SEO/content team to align paid search and organic search strategies.

- Track and troubleshoot conversion tracking and Google Ads attribution issues.



** Amazon PPC

- Create and manage Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.

- Conduct Amazon keyword and competitor research.

- Develop effective campaign structures for new and existing products.

- Manage automatic and manual campaigns.

- Optimize bids, budgets, keywords, search terms, and placements.

- Identify profitable keywords and eliminate wasted ad spend.

- Manage negative keywords and search term harvesting.

- Improve ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and sales performance.

- Analyze Amazon PPC reports and identify opportunities for campaign growth.

- Launch campaigns for new products and optimize existing campaigns.

- Monitor product-level PPC performance and make recommendations for improving listings and conversions.

- Conduct competitor and market research.

- Provide recommendations regarding Amazon listing optimization based on PPC data.



** Analytics & Reporting

- Prepare weekly and monthly PPC performance reports.

- Clearly explain campaign performance, problems, opportunities, and recommended actions.

- Track advertising spend, revenue, conversions, ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CPA, CPC, CTR, and conversion rates.

- Use data to make informed decisions about campaign budgets and strategy.

- Identify trends and opportunities for scaling profitable campaigns.

- Maintain organized campaign records and performance documentation.



**Required Qualifications

- Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Amazon PPC.

- Proven experience managing paid advertising campaigns for e-commerce businesses.

- Strong knowledge of Google Ads and Amazon Advertising platforms.

- Demonstrated experience managing advertising budgets and optimizing for profitability.

- Strong understanding of keyword research and search intent.

- Experience with Google Shopping and/or Performance Max is highly preferred.

- Experience with Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.

- Strong understanding of PPC metrics, including ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CPA, CPC, CTR, and conversion rate.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Ability to provide clear reports and communicate recommendations effectively.



**Preferred Qualifications

- Google Ads certification.

- Amazon Ads certification.

- Experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager.

- Experience with Google Merchant Center.

- Experience with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.

- Experience with Looker Studio or other reporting platforms.

- Experience with PPC tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Data Dive, or similar Amazon research/optimization tools.

- Experience managing large product catalogs.

- Experience with industrial, hardware, home improvement, agricultural, or similar product categories is a plus.



** What We Are Looking For



We want someone who can think strategically but also execute the work themselves.



You should be able to answer questions such as:



Why is a campaign spending money without generating sales?

Which keywords should receive more budget?

Which keywords should be paused or added as negatives?

How can we improve ROAS without sacrificing sales volume?

Which products should receive additional PPC budget?

Why has CPC increased?

Which search terms are generating profitable conversions?

How can Google Ads and Amazon PPC work together to increase overall e-commerce sales?



We are looking for a results-oriented PPC specialist, not someone who simply monitors campaigns.



Compensation



Salary: Negotiable, based on experience and demonstrated results.



We are willing to offer competitive compensation to the right candidate with a proven track record.



How to Apply



Please send the following:



Your updated resume.

A brief description of your Google Ads experience.

A brief description of your Amazon PPC experience.

How many years of hands-on experience you have with each platform.

Examples of e-commerce campaigns you have managed.

Your experience with campaign budgets and approximate monthly ad spend managed.

Examples of results you have achieved, such as improvements in ROAS, ACOS, CPA, conversion rate, or sales.

The PPC tools and software you regularly use.

Your expected monthly salary.

Your availability and preferred working schedule.



Important: Please include “GOOGLE + AMAZON PPC” in the subject/title of your application. Applications without this phrase may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term working relationship and take ownership of our paid advertising growth.

title: Looking For a Rockstar Video Editor Who Can Own Our AI Ad Creative Pipeline
description:
I run a fast-growing paid advertising business and I'm looking for my go-to creative person.



Bluntly, I'm looking for someone who lives and breathes short-form video ads. The kind of person who watches 
 and
 ads and thinks "I could make that better."



Here's how this works:



I write the scripts. You bring them to life.



You're going to learn a lot. We use cutting-edge AI video tools to generate ultra-realistic UGC style footage, and you'll be trained on all of them. If you've ever wanted to get paid to master AI video, this is that job.



Your #1 goal is to own the creative pipeline end to end so the only thing I touch is the script.



This will involve and is not limited to:



- Taking my approved scripts and generating video clips using AI video tools (I'll teach you the tools, you bring the eye)



- Choosing the right voiceover for each ad: tone, pacing, energy that matches the script



- Stitching clips together in CapCut (or your editor of choice) into finished 15-60 second ads



- Direct response style editing: fast hooks, captions burned in, punch-ins, pattern interrupts, nothing slow



- Producing batches of hook variations from one base ad



- Organizing our creative library so nothing gets lost



- Building your own SOPs as you go. I will not be writing documentation for you. You document what you do so the process is repeatable.



- Cutting clips from longer recordings when needed



ABOUT US



We run paid ads on
 and 
 in the home services space, and we teach other marketers how to do the same. Our ads are built almost entirely with AI generated video, and we're early on tools most editors haven't touched yet. You'll be working at the front edge of where ad creative is going.



REQUIREMENTS



- You have edited short-form video before: ads, TikToks, Reels, YouTube Shorts, anything. Show me.



- You have used CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, or any real editor. The specific tool doesn't matter, the instinct does.



- You do NOT need AI video experience. If you've played with any AI tools, great bonus, but I will teach you everything. What I can't teach is taste.



- You speak and write fluent English. You'll need to judge whether a voiceover sounds natural to an American ear.



- You're fast. Our whole model is testing lots of creative quickly. Done and testing beats perfect and late.



- This is a full time role, Monday to Friday. I'm in the UK, and as long as there's SOME crossover in working hours, I'm happy.



- You love feedback. I'll tell you directly what's working and what isn't, and your input on making ads better actually matters to me.



OPPORTUNITIES



- You'll be trained on AI video tools that most editors won't touch for years. This skill set alone will be worth a fortune to you.



- Once we're dialed in, we'll evaluate flexible arrangements. It's not about the hours, it's about the output.



- Pay raises tied to performance. When your ads win, you'll know it and you'll be rewarded for it.



- Take on independent creative projects you're interested in that benefit the business.



WHAT TO EXPECT



- This is a long-term position. I'm building a small team, you plus 2-3 others max. No corporate nonsense, no pointless meetings.



- Don't expect a large SOP library to follow. I expect you to Google, YouTube, and AI-search your way through technical questions. We'll communicate closely to start, but as you grow, you solve problems yourself.



- You'll post a short daily update in our team chat: what you did, what you're stuck on, what you need from me. This is non-negotiable and it's how I stay out of your way.



- Your attitude and willingness to learn are KEY. I will throw things at you that you don't know how to do. Your job is to figure out HOW.



HOW TO APPLY



When applying, put "I'M A CREATIVE ROCKSTAR" in the subject heading and answer the following:

title: Product Researcher for Branded Dropshipping — Japan Market
description:
We are looking for an experienced e-commerce / dropshipping product researcher who can consistently find strong, data-backed products with potential to launch and scale in Japan.



This is not a role for sending random trending products from a spy tool. You will research broadly, analyze the numbers behind opportunities, then aggressively filter them down to the strongest products worth testing.



What you’ll do

• Use tools such as Trendtrack, AdSpy, Meta Ad Library, and competitor/store research tools.

• Find around 20 initial product opportunities per day; filter these to at least 5 highly qualified opportunities.

• Identify competitor brands already succeeding in other markets and assess opportunities for Japan.

• Submit product name/type, niche, competitor store link, spy-tool link, estimated monthly visitors, selling price, estimated revenue where available, seasonality, relevant competitors, and supporting data.



What a strong opportunity looks like

• Existing market awareness and meaningful market potential.

• Approximately ¥12,000+ selling price and potential for 60–65% gross margin.

• Highly visual: clear demonstrations, before/after potential, obvious mechanism or benefits that work in video.

• High perceived value, not easily available locally, and enough creative/angle elasticity to scale.

• Evidence of traction: meaningful or growing traffic/revenue, multiple successful competitors, active ad spend, and substantial creative volume.



You should have experience researching winning dropshipping/DTC products, evaluating stores (not just products), using ad/product spy tools, and making decisions from traffic, revenue, and advertising signals. You should be fast, thorough, and naturally ask: “What evidence tells me this product is actually working?”



This can become a long-term role. When applying, briefly explain your prior dropshipping/e-commerce research experience, the tools you use, and examples of how you judge whether a product is worth testing.

title: SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required
description:
We're Recruiting a SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required



APPLY HERE: 

: 



About Allied Health Media



Allied Health Media (Allied Health Media Limited) is a UK healthcare marketing agency, headquartered in London, founded by Abhay Patel in 2022. It helps private medical consultants grow their practices through AI-driven visibility and patient acquisition — ranking them top-3 on Google Maps and AI search to drive self-pay patient calls. Its core offerings include the 12-month Practice Authority Accelerator program, a website design/build service with ongoing retainer, and the Medical Authority Media Series for video and personal branding, all delivered through an in-house team spanning growth, CS, SEO, production, design, and development.



About the Role



As our SEO Specialist, you'll own the organic search performance of a portfolio of client websites, most of them in healthcare. That means running full technical and on-page audits, catching crawling, indexing, and architecture issues before they hurt rankings, and keeping Core Web Vitals, structured data, and site health in good shape. You'll turn findings into clear, actionable tasks for developers and content teams, then verify the fixes actually landed correctly on the live site — not just take someone's word for it. You'll also track performance through GA4 and Search Console, investigate unusual traffic or ranking shifts, and report on what's working, what isn't, and what should happen next. Because our clients operate in healthcare, you'll need to apply extra care and sound judgement around medical content accuracy, not just chase quick wins.



Do Not Apply If...



You rely solely on automated tool scores instead of professional judgement

You don't follow through to confirm that requested fixes were actually implemented correctly

You're uncomfortable explaining technical SEO issues to non-technical team members

You cut corners on accuracy, especially with medical/healthcare content

You need close supervision to manage multiple client websites and priorities

You're not comfortable learning new SEO tools and platforms.

You don't have a background or practical experience in web development.



Key Responsibilities



Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits, covering crawling, indexing, rendering, and site architecture.

Review and optimise XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, and URL structures.

Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile usability.

Review and troubleshoot structured data and schema markup.

title: Video Editor for D2C E-Commerce Brand | Remote, Full Time | Philippines
description:
We run a portfolio of direct to consumer ecommerce brands in the USA. Our growth comes from one thing: volume and quality of creative. We are building an in house creative team and looking for video editors who want to grow into something bigger than editing.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will produce
 and Instagram video ads for our brands. Every week you will cut new concepts, rework winners into fresh variations, and test new hooks.



A big part of the job is generating your own footage. You will create images and video b roll with AI tools instead of waiting on a shoot. That means writing good prompts, getting consistent characters and products across shots, and knowing when a generation is usable and when it needs another pass.



Day to day this looks like:



• Editing short form video ads for paid social, mostly 9:16

• Generating image and video b roll in Higgsfield and similar platforms

• Building variations of proven ads by changing hooks, pacing, captions, and b roll

• Adding captions, sound design, and music that fit the brand

• Sourcing and organising stock, UGC, and product footage

• Taking direct creative feedback and turning it around fast



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Real experience editing video ads for ecommerce brands, not just general video work

• Strong command of CapCut, Premiere Pro or alternative video editing tools.

• Hands on experience with AI image and video models. Nano Banana Pro, ChatGPT Image, Seedance, Kling 3.0, and Sora are the ones we use most, through platforms like Higgsfield, Freepik, and Artlist

• An eye for pacing and hooks. You understand that the first two seconds d
 everything

• Fast turnaround without dropping quality

• Comfortable working independently, communicating clearly in English, and being reachable during agreed hours

• Reliable internet and a machine that can handle heavy editing and AI workflows



Experience with AI generation tools is close to mandatory. It is part of the daily workflow here, not a bonus skill.



WHERE THIS ROLE GOES



We invest in our editors. You get direct, continuous feedback on your work and access to the data behind what performs. The path here is editor to creative director to team lead. Over time you take on scripting, concepting, and eventually leading other editors.



COMPENSATION



• 700 USD per month during the first month, which is a probation period

• 800 USD per month once you are hired full time

• Higher compensation is on the table after that based on performance and negotiation



HOURS



Full time, 40 hours per week, Philippines time working hours. Start date: ASAP.



HOW TO APPLY



Your application will not be reviewed unless it includes both of the following:



1. A portfolio of video ads you have edited for ecommerce brands. Attach it or include a link (Drive, 
, personal site) in your application.

2. A written description of your experience with AI image and video generation models. Tell us which models and platforms you have used, what you used them for, and what you produced with them. This is required.



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to show proof of their AI work during the interview, so be ready to walk us through your actual generations and how you prompted them.

title: Booking Agent
description:
PIKT Entertainment is an events company in Melbourne, Australia. We supply the DJs, photographers, photo booths and 360 booths for weddings, engagement parties, 21st birthdays and school formals.



People enquire through our website every week and we do not call them all back fast enough. That is your job.



What you will do



Call people who have already enquired. These are warm leads, not cold calls.

Ask about their event, recommend the right package, send the quote.

Follow up until they book or say no. Most people book on the third or fourth call.

Log every call in our CRM.

Hours



9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Manila time, Monday to Friday. Day shift. No graveyard.



Pay



$250 USD per month, plus $[5] USD for every booking you close. 



What you need



Clear spoken English. Australians need to understand you easily on a phone line.



At least 1 year on the phone. Sales, appointment setting or BPO.



Stable internet, 25 Mbps minimum, with a backup connection.



A USB headset with a proper microphone, and a quiet room to work in.



What we give you



You call from our Melbourne number through a browser dialer. You pay nothing for calls.

Full training on our packages, pricing and scripts.

Paid on time every month via [Wise / PayPal].

How to apply



Start your message with MELBOURNE.

Attach your resume.

Record a voice recording on your phone, 60 seconds maximum. Say your name, then tell us about the best party you have ever been to. Speak normally, do not read a script.

No voice recording, no interview. This is a phone job, so we want to hear you.



Notes for you (do not post)

 

Set the bonus properly. At $250 base the bonus is what makes this competitive, so make it worth chasing. $15 a booking is a starting point, not a recommendation, since I do not know your margin per job. Whatever the number, put it in the ad. "Bonuses available" reads as nothing.



Expect entry-level. $250 full time sits at the floor of the platform, so you will get people with less phone experience than the ad asks for. The voice recording is what protects you. Listen to it before you read anything else, and reject anyone you have to concentrate to understand.



The MELBOURNE keyword will remove most of the mass-appliers on its own.

First week should be paid training with you listening in, not solo dialling.

Australian and Philippine public holidays differ. Agree in writing which calendar they follow.

Calls are recorded through the CRM. Tell them, and make sure they tell the customer. Australian law requires it.

We provide lab, office, and cleanroom space, entrepreneurship education, and a collaborative ecosystem that helps biotech, medtech, and greentech founders take their ideas from concept to impact. Our community brings together researchers, startups, and industry partners under one roof to accelerate discovery, validation, and commercialization.



We are seeking an Executive Assistant to support our senior leadership team and coordinate closely with our Marketing & Events and Operations teams at the Innovation Hub. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing a wide range of administrative, back-office, and event-support responsibilities in a fast-paced environment. • Communication: Serve as a primary point of contact for leadership, handling correspondence, drafting
s, and ensuring prompt responses to members, vendors, and partners.

• Information & Document Management: Organize and maintain sensitive documents, contracts, and presentations related to hub operations, programs, and key initiatives.

• Travel Coordination: Manage all aspects of travel arrangements, including booking flights, hotels, and transportation, ensuring seamless logistics for leadership.

• Project Coordination: Assist leadership with ongoing projects, ensuring timelines are met and stakeholders are kept informed.



BACK OFFICE & OPERATIONS SUPPORT

• Invoice Processing: Process incoming vendor invoices and member billing, code and route for approval, and track payment status to ensure timely, accurate payments.

• Accounts Payable/Receivable Support: Assist with expense tracking, reconciliation, and basic bookkeeping tasks in coordination with the finance function.

• CRM Maintenance: Maintain and update records in the Company's CRM and membership management platform (e.g., Nexudus), including member and contact data, renewals, and activity logs.

• Vendor & Contract Records: Maintain organized vendor files, service agreements, and renewal timelines; support procurement of office and hub supplies.

• Data Entry & Reporting: Maintain accurate operational records and generate routine reports on invoicing, membership, and administrative metrics for leadership.



MARKETING & EVENT COORDINATION

• Collaboration with Marketing/Events Team: Work closely with the Innovation Hub's Marketing and Events team to coordinate logistics for meetings, workshops, tours, networking sessions, and other hub events.

• Event Preparation: Assist in preparing and distributing materials, presentations, and invitations for events hosted at the Innovation Hub, ensuring alignment with the Company's branding and communication standards.

• Event Scheduling: Manage event schedules for leadership, ensuring key stakeholders are informed of upcoming events and prepared accordingly.

• Post-Event Follow-Up: Coordinate post-event communication, sending out thank-you notes, gathering feedback, and helping the marketing team with event summaries and reports.

• Brand & Content Support: Assist the Marketing team in managing leadership participation in branding initiatives, thought leadership, and speaking engagements.

• Stakeholder Coordination: Work with members, vendors, and external partners to ensure seamless communication and coordination for joint projects or events at the Innovation Hub.



QUALIFICATIONS

• Proven experience as an Executive Assistant or similar role supporting senior leadership.

• Experience with back-office or administrative operations, including invoice processing, expense tracking, or basic bookkeeping.

• Experience maintaining a CRM or membership management platform (e.g., Nexudus, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar); Nexudus experience a plus.

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including professional phone etiquette.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiarity with virtual communication tools (Zoom, Slack, etc.).

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.

• Bachelor's degree preferred but not required.



WHY JOIN US

Join us for opportunities for career growth and professional development with a dynamic team in the life science innovation and startup ecosystem!

title: Accounting & Marketing Assistant
description:
You have successfully maintained the books and accounting for an Australian business turning over $5 million or more and are now looking for a broader role where you can take on greater responsibility and contribute beyond finance in a key position.



Reporting to the Australian management team, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day bookkeeping and financial administration.  You'll maintain accurate financial records, complete reconciliations, manage accounts payable and receivable, and prepare timely financial information and management reports. You'll also work alongside our external accountant, who manages the BAS and taxation requirements.



Beyond the accounting responsibilities, you'll enjoy a varied role supporting the business in other key areas. This includes coordinating marketing activities with our Australian team to grow Yum Tasmanian’s online presence, assisting with grant applications, and contributing to a range of business initiatives. 



Yum Tasmanian is a proudly Australian, family-owned business that has been supplying premium potatoes throughout Australia for more than 30 years. Beginning as an organic potato producer in 1994, the business has grown into a nationally recognised supplier to major retailers including Coles, Woolworths, IGA, independent retailers and wholesale markets.



Today, the group operates across several businesses within agriculture, fresh produce and related industries. As the business continues to grow, there is a strong focus on building the Yum brand, educating consumers and expanding its online presence through organic marketing.



We want you to be a driver in helping us build Yum into Australia's most recognised online potato brand by growing our organic digital presence to over 1 million Instagram and
 followers through organic marketing.



The role is Monday to Friday, working from an office. In return for your great performance, you’ll be supported with autonomy, rewards and more opportunity for growth over time.



If this sounds like a role you’d enjoy and succeed in, apply now via the link below for more information.
