title: Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead
description:
We have ambitious plans to grow rapidly. Our entire ecosystem has been divided into 4 new positions. We are looking for people who have the knowledge and experience to join our team and take our 23 year old company to the next level.



Feel free to browse our 4 open positions, but do not apply to any if you do not have the experience required. Thanks you.



Here they are:



1. Senior Technical & Ecommerce SEO Lead

2. Off-Page SEO & Paid Search Performance Specialist

3. Creative Strategy & Advertising Content Lead

4. Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead



This ad is for position #4

4. Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead



Paid Social • Ecommerce Growth • Customer Acquisition • Retargeting • Lifecycle Marketing

Full-Time Permanent Position — 40 Hours Per Week

JOB OVERVIEW



We are a 23-year-old printing and manufacturing company looking for an exceptional Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead.



This is NOT a social-media posting position.

This is NOT a content-creator position.

We have separate employees responsible for creative production and staff who can assist with repetitive posting and routine engagement.



We are looking for the marketing brain.

You will be responsible for determining:



WHO we should market to.

WHAT we should market to them.

WHERE we should reach them.

WHEN we should reach them.

WHAT offer they should see.

WHAT stage of the buying journey they are in.

HOW much we should spend acquiring them.

HOW we bring them back if they don't purchase.

HOW we turn first-time customers into repeat customers.

WHETHER the marketing actually made money.



Our objective is not followers.

Our objective is profitable growth.



YOUR MISSION

Build a sophisticated digital customer-acquisition and retention engine capable of helping scale our company toward $10+ million in annual revenue.



No single employee can guarantee that revenue.



Your responsibility is to build, operate and continuously improve the digital-marketing systems that can help us get there.



The system should move customers through:



Awareness > Interest > Consideration > Visit > Lead/Cart > Purchase > Repeat Purchase > Referral



You will work closely with:



Creative Strategy & Advertising Content Lead

Technical/Ecommerce SEO Lead

Paid Search Specialist

Management

Sales/customer-service staff

Social-media VA's



1. DIGITAL MARKETING STRATEGY

Own the complete social/digital marketing strategy.



Determine how we should use:




Instagram

TikTok

YouTube

Pinterest

LinkedIn


SMS

Influencers

Creators

Customer lists

Retargeting

Marketing automation

Landing pages

CRM data



Do not advertise somewhere merely because it exists.



You must explain:



Why we're using it

Who we're targeting

What outcome we expect

How we're measuring it



2. CUSTOMER & MARKET SEGMENTATION

We sell products that can appeal to very different customers.



For custom shirts, examples may include:



Schools

Sports teams

Restaurants

Contractors

Churches

Companies

Events

Clubs

Nonprofits

Family reunions

Gyms

Retail businesses



For yard signs:

Realtors

Contractors

Landscapers

Schools

Events

Graduations

Businesses

Political campaigns where appropriate

Property services

Community organizations



These audiences should NOT all receive the same advertisement.



Develop distinct:

Audiences

Messages

Offers

Creative briefs

Landing pages

Retargeting

Follow-up



3. CUSTOMER PERSONAS & BUYING INTENT



Understand:

Who buys

Why they buy

What problem they're solving

How quickly they need it

What prevents them from buying

What competitors they're considering

What matters most: price, speed, quality, convenience, service or customization

How often they reorder

What else they may purchase



Turn customer knowledge into marketing strategy.



4. META ADVERTISING



You must be highly experienced with:

Meta Business Manager

Meta Ads Manager

 Ads

Instagram Ads

Meta Pixel

Events Manager

Conversion API concepts

Custom audiences

Engagement audiences

Prospecting

Retargeting

You should know how to build campaigns from scratch and improve them over time.



5. TIKTOK MARKETING & ADVERTISING



Understand both organic TikTok behavior and TikTok Ads Manager.



Know how to:



Identify TikTok-native creative

Select objectives

Build campaigns

Develop audiences

Retarget

Test creative

Read performance

Use Pixel/Events data

Scale winners

Kill poor performers



Work closely with the Creative Lead to produce platform-native assets.



6. YOUTUBE



Develop opportunities through:



YouTube content

YouTube Shorts

Video advertising

Retargeting

Product demonstrations

Educational content

Customer-intent content



Determine which videos are brand-building and which are direct-response assets.



7. PINTEREST



Evaluate and utilize Pinterest when appropriate for visually driven products including:



Apparel

Signs

Design inspiration

Events

Weddings

Business branding

Promotional materials



Understand the difference between Pinterest content strategy and paid Pinterest acquisition.



8. LINKEDIN / B2B DIGITAL MARKETING



Develop B2B opportunities where economically justified.



Potential audiences include:



Companies

Marketing managers

Restaurants

Franchises

9. PAID SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY



Own:



Campaign architecture

Audiences

Objectives

Budgets

Placements

Bidding/optimization strategy

Prospecting

Retargeting

Testing

Scaling

Exclusions

Frequency

Creative rotation

Campaign analysis



The Creative Lead makes the creative.



You make sure the right creative reaches the right person.



10. CREATIVE BRIEFING



You must understand creative even though you are not our primary creative producer.



Example:



Instead of telling the Creative Lead:



"Make me five
 ads."



You should be capable of saying:



"We're targeting youth baseball-team managers. Price is not their biggest problem—ordering 15 different names and numbers correctly is. I want three 15-second videos built around simplifying team ordering. Give me one testimonial angle, one problem/solution angle and one demonstration."



THAT is marketing.



You provide the business/customer insight.



The Creative Lead turns it into excellent creative.



11. CREATIVE PERFORMANCE FEEDBACK



You will provide the Creative Lead with data.



Example:



Creative A:

High hook rate, low CTR.



Creative B:

Lower watch time but excellent purchase rate.



Creative C:

Strong CTR but terrible conversion rate.



Creative D:

Excellent ROAS but beginning to fatigue.



Your job is to interpret those results and request the next round of creative intelligently.



12. RETARGETING SYSTEMS



Build sophisticated retargeting journeys.



Examples:



Website visitor



Viewed shirt page.



> Shirt benefit advertisement.



Repeat visit



Still did not buy.



> Testimonial/social-proof advertisement.



Added to cart



Didn't purchase.



> Cart-recovery advertising +
/SMS.



Purchased



Remove from new-customer acquisition advertising.



> Cross-sell.



60/90/180 days later



> Reorder/win-back campaign where appropriate.



Different behavior should trigger different marketing.



13. FIRST-PARTY CUSTOMER DATA



Develop strategies around properly obtained customer data.



Segment by:



Product purchased

Purchase date

Frequency

Order value

Customer type

Geographic area

Lifetime value

Engagement

Lead vs. customer

Lapsed customer



Use appropriately on supported platforms for:



Customer Match

Custom audiences

Exclusions

Retention

Reorders

Cross-selling

Prospecting/modelled audiences where supported



Follow applicable privacy and platform requirements.



14.
 MARKETING



Own
 strategy and deployment.



Build automated flows such as:



Welcome



New subscriber> introduction > value > proof > offer.



Abandoned Cart



Cart > reminder > benefits > proof > incentive if justified.



Browse Abandonment



Visited repeatedly > relevant product reminder.



Post Purchase



Confirmation > education > review > cross-sell.



Reorder



Expected replenishment/reorder timeframe > reminder.



Win Back



Customer hasn't purchased recently > targeted return campaign.



VIP



High-value customer > special treatment/offers.



15. SMS MARKETING



Build compliant SMS programs for:



Abandoned carts

Promotions

Limited-time offers

Reorders

Product launches

VIP customers

Customer lifecycle campaigns



Avoid destroying customer trust through excessive messaging.



16. CROSS-SELLING & UPSELLING



Customers buying one product may need another.



Examples:



Business cards > flyers.



Yard signs > banners.



Custom shirts > signs.



Event printing > apparel.



Restaurant menus > uniforms/signage.



Develop data-driven cross-sell and upsell campaigns.



17. CUSTOMER LIFETIME VALUE



You must think beyond the first transaction.



Understand:



CAC

First-order value

Average order value

Purchase frequency

Repeat purchase rate

Customer lifetime value

Gross margin where provided

Payback period



Sometimes spending $100 to acquire a $75 first order can make sense.



Sometimes spending $20 to acquire a $75 order is terrible.



The answer depends on margin, repeat purchases and lifetime value.



Think like a business owner.



18. FUNNEL DEVELOPMENT



Create complete funnels.



Examples:



Social Ad > Landing Page > Purchase



or:



Video > Lead Form >
/SMS > Quote ? Sale



or:



Educational Content > Retargeting > Product Page > Purchase



or:



Customer List > Reorder Offer > Purchase



Every campaign should have an intentional next step.



19. LANDING-PAGE STRATEGY



You do not need to code the pages.



You DO need to understand what makes them convert.



Recommend:



Headlines

Layout

Videos

20. OFFER STRATEGY



A great advertisement cannot always overcome a bad offer.



Develop and test:



Percentage discounts

Quantity breaks

Free shipping

Bundles

Free design assistance

Limited-time offers

21. A/B AND MULTIVARIATE TESTING

Creative

Hooks

Audiences

Landing pages

Headlines

CTAs

 subject lines

22. MARKETING AUTOMATION



Design automated workflows using systems such as:



Zapier

/SMS platforms

Lead forms

Example:

Own the business side of influencer/creator campaigns.



You determine:

Audience fit

25. ORGANIC SOCIAL STRATEGY



Our VAs can perform repetitive posting.

Content mix

Promotions

description:
About Dreambound



Dreambound helps people in the US find and enroll in career training programs, from healthcare to trades to tech.
 is one of our revenue channels, and we're investing in taking it to the next level.



About the Role



We're looking for a senior
 marketing specialist to strengthen and scale our
 program. You'll work inside 
, running lifecycle campaigns and daily broadcasts to an engaged US audience, with revenue tracked end to end through our affiliate platform (Everflow).



This is a hands-on expert role. You'll be trusted with real revenue responsibility: our goal is to grow
 revenue roughly 10% month over month while keeping our sender reputation healthy. You should be the kind of person who spots a deliverability dip before anyone else does and already has a fix in motion. You will work closely with our EM team that will help you execute your strategies.



What You'll Do



*Lifecycle campaigns

     - Build, QA, and run automated campaigns around the lead journey (form funnel follow-ups, application nudges, re-engagement, rejection flows)

     - Verify enrollments, segments, and trigger events are firing correctly, and catch silent exclusions before they cost revenue

     - Build tracking links from scratch in Everflow with correct parameters so every click and conversion attributes accurately



*Testing and optimization

     - Keep at least one A/B test live on every active campaign, one element at a time, resolved cleanly

     - Match the metric to the test: subject lines to open rate, CTAs to click rate, everything ultimately to revenue

     - Use daily broadcasts as your idea lab, then promote winners into campaigns



*Deliverability and metrics

     - Own deliverability: Google Postmaster Tools, 
 deliverability tab, list hygiene, engagement filters, sunset policies

     - Hold our target thresholds on every send (delivered above 98%, open above 25%, click above 2%, unsub below 0.2%, hard bounce below 0.5%, spam below 0.08%)



*Communication

     - Flag issues early with a proposed solution, confirm task understanding in your own words, follow through same-day

     - Study competitor
 programs and bring the strongest ideas back



What We're Looking For



*Must-haves

     - 4+ years in lifecycle/email marketing with direct revenue accountability, ideally in lead generation, affiliate, edtech, or another performance-driven vertical

     - Expert-level experience in 
 (or deep experience in Iterable, Braze, or Klaviyo with proven ability to switch): segments, event-triggered journeys, Liquid personalization, conversion goals, webhooks

     - Proven deliverability recovery experience: you can walk us through a time you took a domain from Medium/Low reputation back to healthy, and explain the levers you pulled (volume throttling, engaged-only sending, list pruning, warm-up)

     - Fluent in
 authentication and infrastructure: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, one-click unsubscribe, and the current Gmail/Yahoo bulk sender requirements

     - Strong list hygiene instincts: sunset policies, engagement tiering, re-permission campaigns, suppression management, bounce classification (hard vs soft, and what to do with each)

     - Disciplined experimenter: single-variable A/B tests, correct metric per test, statistical patience, clean resolution, documented learnings

     - Sharp direct-response copywriting: subject lines, preview text, CTAs that get clicked by a US consumer audience

     - Data fluency: you can pull your own numbers, separate machine opens from human opens, calculate revenue per send/click, and spot when a metric shift is a tracking bug vs a real change

     - Excellent written English and same-day communication habits



*Strong pluses

     - Affiliate/performance tracking platforms (Everflow): building links, sub-ID structure, postback/pixel debugging

 or manual device testing)

ing large consumer lists (100k+) where reputation mistakes are expensive

title: Virtual Senior Accountant / Bookkeeper (US Real Estate & Healthcare Operations)
description:
We are seeking a highly autonomous, top-tier Senior Multi-Entity Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist to manage the financial architecture of a fast-growing, diverse portfolio. This role oversees the financial operations of multiple distinct entities, including a busy medical clinic practice and an extensive real estate portfolio spanning commercial and residential properties in Arizona and Iowa.

We are specifically looking for a tech-forward, proactive professional who doesn't just manage data manually but leverages modern AI, data pipelines, and automation tools to optimize workflows and reduce manual overhead. You will be responsible for bringing our books to a strict, tax-ready close for our external US CPA firm while driving financial clarity for leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Multi-Entity Accounting: Maintain separate, pristine ledgers for multiple legal entities across healthcare operations and various real estate holding companies. Handle intricate intercompany transactions ("due to/due from" clearing accounts) without blending funds.

Healthcare Revenue & Operations: Reconcile medical billing, insurance payouts, and payer reimbursements against clinic software records. Maintain high attention to detail regarding healthcare revenue cycles.

Real Estate Portfolio Tracking: Monitor tenant ledgers, security deposits, mortgage liabilities, CapEx (capital improvements), depreciation schedules, and escrow accounts for multi-state properties. Track state-specific property tax and insurance deadlines.

Payroll & System Integration: Partner with our third-party payroll provider (ADP). Extract payroll journals, properly map gross wages, employer taxes, and deductions, and post accurate sync entries into QuickBooks Online.

AI & Automation Workflow Design: Actively implement and manage automated receipt/invoice pipelines (e.g., Dext, Hubdoc, QBO Receipts) and explore AI-powered analytics to eliminate data entry and streamline financial reporting.

Financial Modeling & Forecasting: Build and maintain clean cash flow forecasts, budget-to-actual reports, and financial models in Excel/Google Sheets to support executive decision-making.

Required Qualifications

Experience: 5+ years of progressive finance/bookkeeping experience, ideally including healthcare/medical practice or multi-entity (real estate) work.

Software Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO ProAdvisor certification is a strong plus). Elite Excel/Google Sheets skills (advanced formulas, financial modeling).

AI & Automation Track Record: Proven experience leveraging AI tools, macros, integrations, or data pipelines to reduce manual workflows.

Industry Domain Knowledge: Solid familiarity with healthcare revenue cycles, payer reimbursements, or specialized US real estate accounting.

Communication & Mindset: Flawless English communication skills (written and verbal). High degree of integrity, absolute attention to detail, and a fierce ownership mindset—you manage the outcomes, not just the tasks.

Setup: Comfortable working independently in a remote, async-heavy structure, with the flexibility to accommodate key US business needs.

Nice-to-Haves (Highly Valued)

Active CPA, CMA, or local equivalent professional designation.

Direct hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks, Waystar, or similar medical EHR/billing systems.

Familiarity with AI-powered analytics or automated data pipeline tools.

title: Marketing Agency Operations Manager
description:
The Person Who Gets Things Done



This role is unique — because the work will be different every day.



One day, you might clean and restructure a spreadsheet. The next, you could review job applicants, check that social media content has been published correctly, improve a process, follow up with a team member or identify why a project is not moving forward.



The common thread is simple:



Something needs to get done properly, and you make sure it happens.



We are looking for an experienced, highly capable person who can work across the operations of a growing marketing agency.



You do not need to be an expert in every area of marketing. We have processes, systems and training for everything we do.



What we cannot train as easily is judgement.



You need to be able to understand the end goal, work backwards, see the steps required and notice what is missing — without becoming so caught up in minor details that nothing moves forward.



Progress Over Perfection



We care about quality, but we do not believe perfection should prevent progress.



You need to know:



Which details genuinely matter

Which issues need to be resolved immediately

Which improvements can wait

When to keep investigating

When to make a sensible decision and move forward



You will check and double-check your work, but you will not allow perfectionism to become procrastination.



We want someone who creates momentum.



What You Could Be Doing



Your responsibilities will be varied and may include:



Cleaning, organising and maintaining spreadsheets and internal data

Turning repeated tasks into clear processes, checklists and systems

Reviewing work for errors, missing information or inconsistencies

Checking that content, campaigns and social media tasks have been completed correctly

Coordinating projects across different agency departments

Monitoring deadlines, following up on outstanding work and identifying blockers

Reviewing job applications and helping us identify strong candidates

Supporting the onboarding and management of team members

Checking that our processes are being followed and improving them where required

Spotting gaps before they become problems

Taking ownership of unexpected operational tasks

Keeping projects moving without needing constant reminders

Helping us build a stronger team as the agency continues to grow



Sometimes, you will be given a clearly defined task.



Other times, you will be given an outcome and expected to determine the best way to reach it.



Who We Are Looking For



You will ideally have:



Experience working within a marketing agency

Experience in project management, operations or team coordination

Some experience managing people, freelancers or external contractors

Strong written communication and attention to detail

The ability to manage several priorities without losing sight of the main objective

Excellent judgement and practical common sense

The confidence to ask questions when something genuinely is not clear

The initiative to solve straightforward problems independently

The ability to recognise missing steps, risks and weak points

Strong emotional intelligence when working across different departments

A calm, persistent and solutions-focused approach

A low-ego attitude and willingness to embrace the way we work



You do not need to be highly extroverted, sales-focused or comfortable spending your day in meetings.



We have very few meetings and phone calls. Most collaboration happens through written communication, tasks and clearly documented processes.



However, emotional intelligence still matters. You will work across several parts of the agency and need to understand how to communicate respectfully, follow up effectively and work with different personalities.



How We Work



We do not care where you work, what you wear or exactly when you complete your work.



We do not micromanage.



What we do care about is trust, ownership and visible progress.



Freedom comes with accountability. If you say something will be completed, we need to trust that it will be completed — or that you will communicate early if something changes.



There is no ego in our approach. It is not about who is right. It is about finding what works.



You may have done something differently in a previous role. We will listen to your ideas, but you must also be willing to learn and embrace our systems, processes and standards.



Our One Objective



Everything we do comes back to one goal:



Achieving the best possible results for our clients.



Our decisions are not driven by what creates the easiest work or the most short-term profit. We ask what will genuinely help our clients achieve a better outcome.



As we attract more clients, we need better systems, stronger processes and more exceptional people.



Once you understand and embrace that objective, you will be trusted to take ownership, make sensible decisions and pursue the outcome with grace, precision and persistence.



You Will Thrive Here If You…

Naturally take ownership instead of waiting to be chased

Enjoy bringing order to messy or incomplete information

Can move comfortably between small administrative tasks and larger operational challenges

Notice what other people miss

Care about the final result, not just completing your assigned step

Are comfortable receiving varied tasks and d
 how to approach them

Value respect, trust and direct communication

Prefer meaningful work over meetings, office politics and unnecessary bureaucracy

Want the freedom to work independently while contributing to a growing agency

This Role May Not Suit You If You…

Need every task explained step by step before you can begin

Regularly miss details because you do not check your work

Become overwhelmed when priorities change

Focus on being busy rather than producing outcomes

Avoid responsibility when something goes wrong

Need constant supervision, reassurance or reminders

Allow perfectionism to prevent work from being completed

Are more interested in proving your approach is right than finding the best solution

How to Apply



We are less interested in a long, polished cover letter than in understanding how you think.



Please include:



A brief overview of your marketing agency, project management and team management experience.

An example of a messy or unclear task you took ownership of and successfully completed.

An example of a problem or missing step you identified before anyone asked you to look for it.

How you prioritise when several tasks appear urgent.

The systems and project management tools you have used.

Your availability, time zone and expected rate.



If you are intelligent, dependable and exceptionally good at turning intentions into completed work, we would love to hear from you.

title: Pricing Research & Shopify Product VA — Luxury Fashion (Long-term)
description:
We run international luxury fashion e-commerce stores (Shopify, selling to Europe, US, and Australia). We need a careful, detail-obsessed VA for a LONG-TERM role. One person, growing responsibility, no churn — our longest team members have been with us for years.



THE WORK (about 20 hrs/week to start):

1) Weekly competitor price research (the core of the job): for a list of luxury products (Canada Goose, Lemaire, Zegna, Loro Piana, etc.), find the LOWEST LEGITIMATE price online — brand-new condition only, from official brand sites or authorized retailers. You must reject secondhand/resale sites (eBay, Vestiaire, StockX, etc.) and suspicious "outlet" sites. You deliver an evidence spreadsheet: our price, competitor URL, their price, whether it's a sale price, and your recommendation. Accuracy matters more than speed — every price you report must be real and verifiable.

2) Shopify product work (occasional): adding/editing products — photos (light background, clean), descriptions, tags, SEO fields, metafields, CSV uploads.



We encourage using AI tools (ChatGPT etc.) to work faster — but every fact and price must be verified by you on the actual retailer page. 



REQUIREMENTS:

- Experience with e-commerce product research or competitive pricing (or provable ability to learn it fast)

- Shopify admin experience

- Meticulous: you keep change logs, double-check your work, and tell us early if something will be late

- VPN (or willingness to set one up) to check European/US market prices

- Good written English; some working-hours overlap with Hong Kong time

- Long-term intent — we are not looking for a 3-month gig



PAY: $7–10/hour USD depending on experience (≈ $600–850/month at 20 hrs/week), paid reliably. Hours can grow toward full-time as we add stores.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — applications that skip this are rejected without being read):

Start your application with the single word CROISSANT, then answer these 4 questions. Short, specific answers beat long generic ones.

Q1. Name at least 3 websites you would NOT trust when researching competitor prices for new luxury goods, and why.

Q2. Mini-task (10–15 min): Find the lowest legitimate price for the "Canada Goose Women's Expedition Parka" — new condition, from the brand or an authorized retailer. Paste: the URL, the price, and one sentence on why you trust that retailer.

Q3. Your longest client engagement: how long, what you did, why it ended. Plus: how many hours/week you can commit now, and what times of day you work.

Q4. How do you use AI in your work today? And would you trust an AI chatbot's answer about a competitor's current price — why or why not?



We reply to shortlisted applicants within 2 weeks. This is a stable, long-term seat for someone who takes pride in being exact.

title: OpenClaw Agent Engineer - Build AI Agents and Keep Them Running
description:
READ THIS FIRST

 

You must have used OpenClaw before. You must be able to prove it.

 

If you have not used OpenClaw, please do not apply. We will not read your message. We are saying this clearly so we do not waste your time or ours.

 

 

THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

 

You build OpenClaw agents. You keep them running. You make them faster, cheaper and more reliable every week.

 

That is the whole job.

 

 

ABOUT US

 

We are a health and wellness company. We sell products online. We have a small remote team in several countries.

 

We are building a team of AI agents to run parts of our business.

 

 

WHAT IS AN AGENT HERE

 

An agent is a small program that does one job. It runs by itself on a timer. Nobody starts it by hand. It runs at 3am while everyone is asleep.

 

We want 10 to 20 agents. Each one does one job.

 

Three real examples:

 

1) STORE WATCHER. Every 3 hours it checks our online shop. Is checkout working? Is any product priced wrong? Are we selling stock we do not have? If yes, it reports. If no, it says nothing.

 

2) INBOX READER. Twice a day it reads
, Slack, Asana and meeting notes. It works out what is waiting on the owner. Then it writes the replies for him to approve.

 

3) COMPETITOR WATCHER. Once a week it checks what our competitors changed. It only reports the changes.

 

Above all the agents sits one main agent. We call it the Chief of Staff. It manages the other agents. It is the only agent that talks to the owner.

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 

1) BUILD THE PLATFORM. One AWS account. OpenClaw installed and running on a timer. A safe place to store passwords and API keys. A log of every run. A stop button.

 

2) BUILD THE AGENTS. One at a time. We give you a written brief for each one. You d
 how to build it.

 

3) KEEP THEM RUNNING. This is half the job. An agent that stops quietly is worse than no agent at all, because we will trust a silence that means nothing is being checked.

 

4) MAKE THEM BETTER EVERY WEEK.

- Using too much money? Make them cheaper.

- Too slow? Make them faster.

- Sending too many messages? Reduce the noise.

- Failing sometimes? Find out why and fix it.

 

You will send a short report every week: how many runs, how many failures, how much it cost, and what you improved.

 

5) OWN IT. You will be the only person who understands this system. We need you to write things down so that stays safe.

 

 

YOU MUST HAVE

 

1) OPENCLAW EXPERIENCE. This is not optional. You have installed OpenClaw yourself. You have run it. You have fixed it when it broke. We need proof. See the PROOF section below.

 

2) AWS. You have set up EC2 yourself. You know IAM. You have used Secrets Manager or something like it.

 

3) PYTHON. You write code that runs on a server. Not only in a notebook.

 

4) API EXPERIENCE. REST APIs. OAuth. Webhooks. You have handled rate limits and retries. You have worked with an API that gave you wrong data.

 

5) LLM API EXPERIENCE. OpenAI, Anthropic or similar. Inside real code. Not only in a chat window.

 

6) CLEAR WRITTEN ENGLISH. Most of our work is written. You must be able to explain a technical decision in writing.

 

7) TIME OVERLAP. At least 4 hours per day that overlap with Sydney, Australia business hours.

 

 

PROOF OF OPENCLAW EXPERIENCE

 

Your application must include at least one of these. Two is better.

 

OPTION A - A SHORT SCREEN RECORDING. 2 to 3 minutes. Record your own screen. Show OpenClaw running on your machine or your server. Show the config. Show the logs. Show it doing something.

 

OPTION B - A REPOSITORY. A GitHub link with your commit history, showing your OpenClaw setup or an agent you built for it.

 

OPTION C - A LIVE SYSTEM. Something running now that we can look at, or that you can show us on a call.

 

Screenshots alone are not enough. Anyone can send a screenshot. We need to see you working with it.

 

AND ANSWER THESE FIVE QUESTIONS. These are simple if you have really used it. Please answer all five.

 

1) Did you install OpenClaw yourself, or did you use a one-click hosting service or a template? Both answers are fine. We just need to know which one.

 

2) What machine did it run on? Say the operating system and where it was hosted.

 

3) How did you keep it running after you closed your laptop or logged out? Name the exact method you used.

 

4) Where do you look when you want to see what OpenClaw did? Name the file or the command.

 

5) Tell us about one time it broke. What broke, and how did you fix it?

 

 

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF

 

- You have never used OpenClaw

- You cannot show us proof

- You have only used no-code tools and never written code that runs on a server

- You want a job where every task is fully explained before you start

- You are sending the same message to many jobs today

 

 

ONE MORE THING, AND WE MEAN IT

 

We need you to tell us the truth about what you can and cannot do.

 

If something is too hard for you today, say so. We will pay for the course. We will give you the time.

 

What we cannot work with is a date that was never real, or a yes that was really a maybe.

 

Before you start each piece of work, we will ask you to rate it from 1 to 10. 1 is very easy. 10 is very hard. We want the real number. If it is an 8, say 8.

 

This is a real part of the job. It is not a nice sentence in a job advert.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Send a message with all five things below. If anything is missing, we will not read it.

 

1) Start your message with the word HEARTBEAT. This shows us you read the post.

 

2) Your proof of OpenClaw experience. Recording, repository or live system.

 

3) Your answers to the five OpenClaw questions above.

 

4) Your answers to these three questions. Short answers are better than long ones.

 

   a) Tell us about one program you built that ran by itself for 30 days or more. Something broke while nobody was watching. How did you find out it had broken?

 

   b) Your program runs at 3am. Nobody is logged in. It needs an API key to do its job. Where do you keep that key, and why there?

 

   c) Twenty different agents all send messages to one busy person. After one month, that person stops reading them. What do you build so this does not happen?

 

5) Your rate. USD per month, for 40 hours per week.

 

Please write your application yourself. We read a lot of AI writing every day. We are hiring for good thinking, not for good grammar.

 

 

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

 

1) We read your proof and your answers.

2) A 30 minute video call.

3) A paid test project. One week. One small agent. We pay your normal rate. You keep the money even if we do not continue.

4) If it goes well, full time and long term.

title: Trailer Repair Admin
description:
GH Logistics and AJG Transport operate a high-performance freight brokerage and asset-based transportation network specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, clear communication, and accountability. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup through delivery.



If you have experience coordinating equipment repairs, working with drivers and repair vendors, and keeping trailer operations moving during overnight hours, this role provides an opportunity to take ownership of a critical part of our Trailer Management operation.



Role Overview

The Trailer Repair FMT is responsible for maintaining overnight control of trailer repair activity and supporting off-tour Trailer Management operations. Your primary responsibility is to coordinate trailer repairs during the night shift, including high-volume on-road repair activity, while ensuring trailer records, repair statuses, documentation, and operational updates remain accurate in real time. You will work closely with the night repair team, drivers, carriers, repair vendors, facility personnel, and the Trailer Management team to keep equipment issues moving toward resolution. 



The night team is also responsible for verifying and completing work handed off by the day team and delivering a fully reconciled and accurate board for the incoming day shift. This is an operations and repair coordination position. You will not physically repair trailers and you will not have authority to approve company spending.



What You’ll Be Doing



Overnight Trailer Repair Coordination

• Serve as the primary Trailer Management point of coordination for overnight and on-road trailer repairs, working with drivers, carriers, facilities, roadside providers, mobile mechanics, and repair vendors.

• Review reported trailer defects, gather photos, inspection details, diagnoses, estimates, parts information, and other documentation needed to determine the appropriate next step.

• Coordinate roadside service, mobile repairs, terminal repairs, inspections, trailer swaps, or equipment repositioning and follow up on vendor status, parts availability, completion timelines, and return-to-service expectations.

• Continue follow-up on repairs handed off by the day team until they are resolved or properly documented and returned to the day team.

• Escalate repair costs, safety concerns, major equipment issues, and matters requiring financial approval to authorized leadership; this role has no authority to approve spending.



Fleetio and Data Integrity

• Maintain Fleetio records overnight in real time and enter all repair, trailer, and operational updates handled during the shift.

• Ensure trailer repair statuses, locations, assignments, conditions, and related records remain accurate and current.

• Conduct overnight data integrity checks and investigate missing, outdated, conflicting, or incomplete information.

• Update and maintain records involving misused trailers, partner carrier trailers, repair activity, vendors, and supporting documentation.

• Identify and resolve discrepancies between operational information and system records before the morning handoff whenever possible.



Off-Tour Trailer Operations

• Run the required overnight trailer classification sweep and identify trailers requiring correction, investigation, or follow-up.

• Close operational gaps and unfinished trailer-related work handed off by the day team.

• Assist carriers requiring trailers and coordinate trailer availability, loading, seating, assignments, and related movements.

• Monitor and address trailer concerns that may affect drivers, facilities, customers, freight movement, or equipment availability.

• Handle additional overnight trailer-related tasks and maintain communication with facility personnel and designated internal operational contacts.



Documentation and Morning Handoff

• Maintain complete and organized trailer repair paperwork and supporting documentation throughout the shift.

• Clearly document completed work, pending repairs, vendor responses, equipment concerns, unresolved issues, and required follow-ups.

• Verify items handed off by the day team and document what was completed, remains pending, or requires escalation.

• Ensure every unresolved item has clear ownership, an accurate current status, documented next steps, and a proper handoff.

• Deliver the 8 AM handoff complete and on time, including a reconciled board accurately reflecting trailer locations, statuses, repairs, outstanding issues, and required follow-ups.



What Success Looks Like

• Overnight and on-road trailer repairs are acknowledged quickly, coordinated effectively, and consistently followed through toward resolution.

• Fleetio, trailer classifications, repair records, and other operational data remain accurate and updated in real time throughout the shift.

• Drivers, carriers, vendors, facilities, and internal teams receive timely and clear communication regarding repair and trailer needs.

• Repair documentation, escalations, and unresolved issues are complete, organized, and properly handed off without unauthorized spending decisions.

• The day team receives a complete 8:00 AM handoff with a fully reconciled trailer board showing completed, pending, and escalated items.



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in trailer management, fleet operations, dispatch, transportation, roadside assistance, or maintenance coordination.

• Knowledge of common trailer repairs, components, equipment defects, and maintenance terminology; repair coordination experience preferred.

• Able to review driver reports, photos, inspections, diagnoses, and estimates, ask the right follow-up questions, and determine appropriate next steps.

• Strong communication, attention to detail, problem-solving, prioritization, and follow-through in a fast-paced overnight operation.

• Comfortable working independently and using Fleetio or similar fleet systems; Samsara, LoadStop, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace experience is a plus.

• Minimum 50 WPM typing speed, strong written and verbal English, and a reliable remote setup with backup internet and power.



Schedule and Work Setup

• Long term and full time remote independent contractor role

• Direct engagement with a US company, not an agency or BPO

• Current shift availability: Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT

• Consistent availability during the assigned US shift is required

• Zoom presence with camera on throughout the shift is required

• Time tracking software, including Hubstaff or another platform, may be implemented as operationally required



What You’ll Get

• Independent contractor setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend, with eligibility beginning 30 days after hire

• Reliable biweekly payments

• A stable, long-term opportunity that is not seasonal or project-based

• Direct exposure to a live US transportation and fleet operation

• Meaningful responsibility over overnight trailer repair activity

• Opportunities to develop deeper experience in Trailer Management, fleet maintenance, repair coordination, and transportation operations

• Potential growth within Trailer Management, Fleet Operations, Maintenance Coordination, or broader logistics operations



This role is built for someone who can keep control of trailer repairs after hours. You will not simply receive repair requests and pass them along. You will coordinate the response, maintain accurate Fleetio records, follow open repairs, support overnight trailer needs, clean up operational discrepancies, document what happened, and make sure the day team receives a reliable and reconciled picture of the operation every morning.

title: Concrete Estimator / Quantity Surveyor
description:
Water Built is an Australian concrete and early works subcontractor based in South East Queensland. We tender concrete packages to head contractors — structural formwork, reinforcement, place and finish, slabs, pavements and civil works — and we are looking for an estimator to take over the measurement side of that work.



WHAT THE ROLE IS



You measure. We price. You will not be asked to build rates, source suppliers or price materials — we apply our own rate library to your quantities. Your job is to produce quantities we can trust without re-measuring.



Typical work:

- Quantity takeoffs from tender drawings: concrete volume (m3), formwork face area (m2), reinforcement tonnage (t), finishes and pavements

- Working inside our Bluebeam Revu tool set, which we provide, so every takeoff is measured the same way every time

- Filling out our standard takeoff template in Excel

- Flagging drawing ambiguities, conflicts and missing information as RFIs before they become pricing errors

- Recording assumptions clearly so anyone can follow how a number was reached



Volume is steady. Tenders come in most weeks and we respond to all of them.



WHAT WE NEED



- Demonstrated concrete and structural takeoff experience: formwork, reinforcement and in-situ concrete specifically. Multi-trade generalists are not the right fit

- Confident reading structural and civil drawings, including reo schedules and section details

- Measurement experience in Bluebeam Revu, PlanSwift, CostX or similar. If you are strong in another package we will train you on our Bluebeam tool set

- Genuine attention to detail. We would rather have a correct number a day later than a fast number that is wrong

- Clear written English. You will be drafting RFIs and assumption notes that go to head contractors

- Overlap with Brisbane business hours (AEST, UTC+10)



Site experience as an engineer or supervisor is a strong advantage. Understanding why formwork gets stripped and re-erected, or why a pour break changes the number, matters more to us than software fluency.



Australian project experience is helpful but not essential. Our template and tool set are the standard you will work to, so we can bridge the gap on local conventions.



HOW WE HIRE



We start everyone with one paid trial takeoff on a job we have already measured, so we can compare your quantities against known-correct numbers. It is paid at your normal rate regardless of outcome.



This is intended to become a long-term, full-time role for the right person, working as part of our team with a Water Built
 address and full software licences provided.

title: Grant Researcher & Proposal Writer – Canadian Funding
description:
**Type:** Part-Time – Long-Term Opportunity

**Hours:** 20 hours per week to start

**Location:** Remote – Philippines

**Salary:** Negotiable

**Schedule:** Flexible, with some availability during Canadian Eastern Time



## About the Position



We are a Canadian organization looking for an intelligent, resourceful, and highly organized **Grant Researcher & Proposal Writer** to join our team remotely.



This is **NOT a general Virtual Assistant position.**



Your primary responsibility will be to find funding opportunities in Canada and help us develop strong applications.



We need someone who can independently research opportunities, determine whether we qualify, explain why an opportunity is worth pursuing, and prepare professional funding applications.



## Your Responsibilities



### Grant Research



You will:



* Research Canadian federal, provincial and municipal grants.

* Research foundations, corporate giving programs and community funding.

* Search government funding portals and other grant databases.

* Identify less obvious funding opportunities.

* Determine eligibility before recommending a grant.

* Identify application deadlines, funding amounts and requirements.

* Research relevant statistics and supporting information.

* Identify potential partnerships and other opportunities that could benefit the organization.



### Grant Writing



You will:



* Prepare grant applications and proposals.

* Write Letters of Intent and funding requests.

* Develop needs statements, program descriptions, objectives and measurable outcomes.

* Assist with grant budgets and supporting documentation.

* Edit and proofread applications before submission.

* Ensure applications directly answer the funder's requirements.



### Grant Management



You will maintain an organized Grant Tracker showing:



* Funding opportunity

* Funder

* Amount available

* Eligibility

* Deadline

* Application requirements

* Website/source

* Status

* Date submitted

* Follow-up date

* Result



You will also provide regular updates on upcoming funding opportunities and application deadlines.



## Who We Are Looking For



We want someone who is naturally curious and enjoys research.



You should be the type of person who doesn't stop after the first Google search.



If information is difficult to find, you keep investigating.



You should be able to come back to management and say:



“I researched this opportunity. We appear to qualify because of A, B and C. The maximum funding is X. The deadline is Y. These are the documents we need, and I recommend that we apply.”



We value **accuracy, initiative and judgment** more than simply producing a large volume of applications.



## Requirements



You must have:



* Excellent written English

* Excellent online research skills

* Strong professional writing ability

* Excellent attention to detail

* Ability to work independently

* Strong critical-thinking skills

* Ability to follow detailed instructions

* Strong organizational skills

* Experience with Google Docs and Google Sheets or Microsoft Office

* Reliable computer and internet connection



Previous grant-writing, proposal-writing, research, nonprofit, academic research or government-funding experience is strongly preferred.



Experience researching Canadian, American, UK or Australian grants is an asset.



## AI Use



You may use tools such as ChatGPT to assist with your work.



However, **AI-generated information must never be submitted without verification.**



You are responsible for checking eligibility, deadlines, funding amounts and requirements directly from reliable or original sources.



We are hiring a **researcher and thinker**, not someone who simply copies AI-generated answers.



## HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words:



**CANADA GRANT RESEARCH**



Applications that do not begin with these words may not be reviewed.



Then answer the following:



1. How many years of research and/or grant-writing experience do you have?



2. What types of grants or funding opportunities have you researched?



3. Have you helped secure any grants? If yes, approximately how much?



4. Have you researched Canadian grants before?



5. What websites, databases or research methods do you normally use to find grants?



6. Describe one difficult research assignment you completed and how you found the information.



7. What is your expected hourly rate?



8. What hours are you available to work?



9. Please provide one writing or research sample.



## RESEARCH TEST



Please complete the following short exercise.



Imagine you are researching funding for a **Canadian nonprofit organization providing residential and community-based programs for children and youth.**



Find **TWO currently relevant Canadian funding opportunities** that the organization could potentially pursue.



For each opportunity provide:



* Name of funding program

* Funding organization

* Website/source

* Maximum funding available, if stated

* Eligibility requirements

* Application deadline

* Why the organization may qualify

* Any restrictions or concerns you identified



**Important:** Verify the information from the original funding source whenever possible.



Do not simply provide two links. We want to see your ability to **research, analyze and make recommendations.**



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview.



This is intended to become a **long-term position for the right person.**

title: Content Publishing VA (Claude + Scheduling, Part Time)
description:
Hi! I'm Aaron. I run a personal brand where I teach people how to build a business with AI.



Salary: $120 per month, reviewed at 90 days



I make the content. I need one reliable person to draft the copy and get everything out the door.



Right now I do all of it myself. Writing, uploads, scheduling, across LinkedIn, X, YouTube, TikTok,
, and Instagram. It eats my nights. I want to hand it off.



This starts small. If you're good, the hours and the pay go up.



What you'd do each week



Run my Claude prompts to draft YouTube descriptions, captions, hooks, and titles

Pull finished videos and graphics from a Google Drive folder

Schedule and upload everything across six platforms

Upload YouTube videos with the titles, descriptions, tags, and end screens

Post short clips to TikTok, Reels, and Shorts

Keep a simple content tracker updated

Use Claude Cowork to pull the numbers and build my report three times a week, using a template I give you



Working with Claude



Most of this job runs through Claude.



I'll give you a set of prompts I already use, loaded into a Project with my brand voice and my best performing posts. You'll run them to draft the copy.



You are not inventing the voice. I already built it. Your job is to run the prompt, read what comes back, and know when it's off. Claude will sometimes write something that reads fine but doesn't sound like me. I need you to catch that and run it again instead of shipping it.



You'll also work in Claude Cowork, the agent workspace that handles multi step tasks across files and connectors. That's what builds my report. If you've used Cowork before, say so and tell me what you built with it. If you haven't, tell me honestly and I'll train you. What I won't accept is someone claiming experience they don't have, because I'll find out in week one.



If you've used AI for real work and you have opinions about when the output is bad, you'll do well here. If you've only ever copied whatever the AI handed you, this isn't the role.



I provide the Claude account.



What you don't do



You won't set the strategy. I do that. You won't be on camera. You won't be on calls at odd hours. You won't be asked to build a following from scratch. This is careful, repeatable work.



Who I'm looking for



You've published across multiple social platforms before. Tell me which ones.

You notice details. Wrong thumbnail, missing caption, video posted the wrong way around. You catch those before I do.

You follow a written process exactly, and you ask when something isn't covered.

You reply within one business day.

Your English is good enough to read instructions, judge a draft, and write a clear update.



Nice to have



Basic Canva or Claude Design skills

You've worked with a content creator or a personal brand before



The setup



10 hours a week, flexible. I'm in California. Set your own hours as long as posts go out on schedule. Weekly check in over chat or Loom. Long term role, not a one off project.



How to apply



Put QUEUE MASTER at the top of your message. I read those first.



Then answer three things. Keep them short.



Which platforms you've published to, and which scheduler you used

Have you used Claude Cowork? If yes, what did you build with it. If no, say so and name the AI tools you do use.

A tool you taught yourself recently, and how you learned it



Then do this quick test. Fifteen minutes.



Below are three versions of the same YouTube title. My voice is simple, short, funny, and written the way I talk. No corporate words.



Leveraging AI to Fundamentally Transform Your Content Workflow

How I Post 30 Times a Week Without Losing My Mind

The Ruthless System Top Creators Use To Dominate Content



Tell me which one is mine, and why the other two are wrong. One sentence each.



Then write a fourth title that beats all three.



I'm not testing your writing. I'm testing whether you can tell good output from bad.

 with your CV and a short note on a production system you've owned. Shortlisted candidates complete an online assessment, then a paid 1–2 week trial project.

title: Performance Video Editor (High Salary)
description:
Performance Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience + uncapped performance bonuses



About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewellery brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for traveller's, with new products launching soon. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram.



This role is video, end to end. You'll concept and cut short-form video ads for paid media across TikTok, Reels, and Meta placements, where every edit is judged on what it does to hook rate, retention, and spend. You're not making brand films or organic filler. You're making the creative we put budget behind.



We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals, not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us 2+ years, and the people who now set our creative direction started as editors here.



You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.



Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Performance Video Editor.



That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. At that level you have full creative autonomy: you own video concepts end to end, you d
 which angles we test next instead of receiving briefs, your creatives are the ones we put real spend behind, and you start reviewing other editors' cuts and shaping how they work.



It's d
 by performance, not time served. Move faster if your work moves faster.



Compensation & Earning Potential

Base: $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience

Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid per winning creative. Every video that hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid ads pays out.

Rate reviews: Revisited as you take on more, not on an annual calendar

Our top editors earn meaningfully more than their base because they produce winners consistently. That's the whole design: we'd rather pay a lot for creatives that work than a little for creatives that don't.



What Success Looks Like

After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form video ads that scale on paid and perform organically, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.



Core Responsibilities

Concept and edit short-form video ads for TikTok, Reels, and Meta, built around hook rate, retention, and watch time rather than aesthetics

Develop new video angles and hooks, then test them against our proven formats

Build AI-assisted video creative using current tools, and keep pace as those tools change

Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes

Work directly from paid performance data to d
 what to cut next

Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day, with no check-ins required

Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where they'll actually convert

Must-Haves

A strong recent portfolio of short-form video edits, ideally including paid ad creative (20+ from the last few months)

You can watch a winning video ad and break down exactly what made it work

Hands-on experience across video formats: hook-led headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, UGC-style edits, AI video

Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time, spend) and know what to change in the next cut

Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice

Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently

Nice-to-Haves

Experience cutting video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

Experience working directly against Meta or TikTok ad account data

A track record of creatives that scaled on paid

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing jobs teach you software. This one teaches you why video sells.



Direct access to paid performance data on real ad spend, so you see exactly which of your creatives print and which die

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software, including the AI video tools you'll be working in

A portfolio backed by numbers, not vibes. "This cut did 4M views and scaled to $X/day" is a career asset that follows you.

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You can't point to a recent video ad and explain why it performed

You want to make beautiful videos more than videos that sell

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), AI video tools, TikTok/Meta analytics

Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.



APPLY HERE:

title: Social Media Manager (Remote)
description:
Read this first



We're not hiring a "content creator." We're not hiring someone who reposts trends with a slightly different caption. We're hiring the person who makes other agencies' social managers nervous.



If you've ever looked at a brand's Instagram and thought "I could fix this in an afternoon," and you actually could, keep reading. If you needed that last sentence explained to you, this isn't your role.



The job



You'll run social media strategy, content, and execution for a portfolio of real clients across hospitality, golf, food and beverage, professional services, and e-commerce. Not one brand. Several. All expecting results, not vibes.



That means:



Building content strategy that's tied to actual business goals, not just "post more"

Designing scroll-stopping creative in Canva that looks like it came from a proper design team, because it did (you)

Writing copy that sounds human, sells without sounding like it's selling, and doesn't read like it was generated in three seconds (even if it was, nobody should ever know)

Spotting opportunities before anyone asks you to. We want ideas landing in our inbox, not requests landing in yours

Managing content calendars, deadlines, and client expectations without needing a babysitter

Who you are

Minimum 3 years experience in social media management, ideally agency-side where you've had to juggle multiple clients and zero excuses

A genuine talent for design. Canva is your instrument and you play it well

A copywriter who understands tone, not just grammar

Strategic. You can explain why a post works, not just that it did

Proactive to the point of mild inconvenience for people who like being asked what to do

Comfortable with feedback, allergic to mediocrity

What you're not

Someone who needs a brief for every single post

Someone who thinks "engagement" means replying to your own comments

Someone applying because the salary looked good and you'll "figure the rest out"

The pay



₱90,000 to ₱110,000 per month, depending on how good you actually are. Fair warning: we mean that. Come in with a portfolio that backs it up.



How to apply



Send us your portfolio, your CV, and one sentence on the best result you've ever gotten a client. If you can't point to a number, a result, or a genuine "this worked," we're not the right fit for each other.



Please don't apply if you're hoping to grow into this role. We need someone who already is this.
